programmes.st: Imitation Is The Sincerest Form Of Insult
programmes.d: Roy’s hilarious “Paul" disguise causes mirth and mayhem at an auction in downtown Toronto.

Nearly all the buyers have it out for each other at an auction in Cedarbrae, ON. Cindy almost comes to blows with Ursula, who takes great pleasure in bidding up Roy, who does his best to give Paul and Bogart the worst advice ever.
Roy brings a “Roy-Puppet” to an auction in Brampton, and they’re both very naughty little boys.

programmes.st: Paul and Bogart Make a Promo
programmes.d: Paul and Bogart shoot a low-budget commercial for their store during an auction in Toronto.
An out-of-town auction in London, Ontario gives rise to new treasures and old grudges.
Roy immediately regrets bringing his little brother to an auction in Toronto when all his enemies fall for the charming young man.
Ursula’s private investigator husband spies on the buyers at an auction in Markham.
Bogart finally snaps when Paul buys yet another lousy locker at an auction in Toronto’s Liberty Village.

In this feel-good apocalyptic comedy, Liza (Zoe Lister-Jones) embarks on a hilarious journey through LA in hopes of making it to her last party before it all ends, running into an eclectic cast of characters along the way.

Henry Golding, Sam Neill, and Noomi Rapace star in this action-packed thriller. An elite assassin is given his final contract to kill six people around the world - only to discover the targets are equally skilled assassins hired to kill him.
In Kevin Smith's most personal film to date, a teenage cinephile tries to woo the girl of his dreams while dealing with a hilarious mix of friends and enemies at his local cinema.

Jonathan Majors (Creed III) and Glen Powell (Top Gun: Maverick) star in the epic and inspirational true story of two elite US fighter pilots during the Korean War. Their heroic sacrifices would ultimately make them the Navy's most celebrated wingmen.

Henry Golding, Sam Neill, and Noomi Rapace star in this action-packed thriller. An elite assassin is given his final contract to kill six people around the world - only to discover the targets are equally skilled assassins hired to kill him.
A rookie cop finds himself in the middle of a deadly heist involving crooked cops and the Russian mob.

Following the deadly events at home, the Abbott family (Emily Blunt, Millicent Simmonds, Noah Jupe) continues their fight for survival in silence, now facing the terrors of the outside world in this suspenseful thriller directed by John Krasinski.

Evan McCauley has skills he never learned and memories of places he has never visited. Self-medicated and on the brink of a mental breakdown, a secret group that call themselves Infinites come to his rescue, revealing that his memories are real.

Jerry Maguire is a sports agent who reaches a crisis point in his life when he decides to become an honorable man. Follow his journey to redemption through an unlikely alliance with a female accountant, and his least important client.
Patrick Swayze and Jennifer Grey star in this spirit-lifting story about a summer love affair between a naïve 17-year-old girl and a charismatic dance instructor at a Catskills hotel. Rated PG-13

The story of a minor-league North Carolina baseball team (the Triple A Durham Bulls) and its attentive, intelligent groupie who feels it is her mission to live with one young player per season and help him mature.
Loner Zack Mayo (Richard Gere) enters Officer Candidate School to become a Navy pilot, and in thirteen torturous weeks, he learns the importance of discipline, love, and friendship.
A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and, therefore, all youthful joy have been banned.
Patrick Swayze and Jennifer Grey star in this spirit-lifting story about a summer love affair between a naïve 17-year-old girl and a charismatic dance instructor at a Catskills hotel. Rated PG-13
Steve Martin turns in a heartwarming and hilarious performance.

As Harry Burns and Sally Albright build their lives and careers in Manhattan, their paths continue to cross, and their friendship continues to grow … until they confront the decision whether to let their friendship develop into romance.
Taliesin takes the young warlock to the crystal cave and shows Merlin a glimpse of the future.
Arthur is pressured into an arranged marriage with a visiting princess, Elena.
Gwen finds herself with an impossible dilemma when she is forced to choose between Arthur and her brother.
Arthur embarks on a solitary quest to prove himself worthy of the Camelot throne.

programmes.st: Love in the Time of Dragons
programmes.d: When an old flame of Gaius' arrives in Camelot, Merlin is pleased to see a different side to his mentor.
Morgana is tormented by dreams of Guinevere becoming Queen of Camelot.
The only rule in Camelot's legendary tournament is that there are no rules.
Merlin and Arthur are sent to capture the Cup of Life, a powerful artifact carrying the gift of immortality.
Queen Morgana begins a reign of terrible evil over the innocent citizens of Camelot.
Morgana summons the mighty Callieach to tear open the veil between the worlds.

Mary and Darnley wed in a lavish affair, which proves to be a successful decision in regards to her political standing. James makes an interesting discovery about Greer, while Elizabeth frantically tries to salvage England's power.

As Mary strategizes ways to take over the English throne, Elizabeth struggles to find an appropriate suitor to marry.  Meanwhile, James gets caught up in a scheme orchestrated by John Knox and has to deal with the tragic aftermath.
Mary and Darnley are at odds as they put their plan to seize England into action.  Elizabeth is conflicted about her feelings for Gideon as she attempts to find a Catholic to marry.

After a tragic earthquake hits Scotland, Mary must face John Knox amidst claims that she isn't coming to the aid of her people. Elizabeth takes drastic measures after she is discovered with Gideon, while Charles makes a decision that backfires.
Darnley teams up with John Knox to strip Mary of her throne, which will leave a close friend of Mary's dead.  Elizabeth must banish Gideon from court at the request of her future husband.

programmes.st: A Bride. A Box. A Body.
programmes.d: Mary pursues her quest for justice as she launches a counter attack on her conspirators. Elizabeth suffers a major setback that turns her world upside down.

Childbirth threatens to take Mary's life, which leaves her and her unborn child's safety in jeopardy. Elizabeth discovers that someone in her inner circle was the cause of the death of someone close to her.
There's more than one Observer! When one of the series' mysterious Observers kidnaps a woman, the Fringe team is called in to investigate why.
After a cargo ship runs aground, the Fringe team investigates a mysterious parasitic organism when the shoreline becomes littered with bodies hosting a giant squid-like creature.
Dr. Walter Bishop's braininess takes on a new meaning when the Fringe team investigate impromptu brain surgeries — and William Bell (LEONARD NIMOY) resurfaces.
A resurrected girl with unexpected ties to a missing soldier requires some fringe intervention in a special unearthed episode from the first season.
Following an unexplained attack, the Fringe team visits a small town where a population of disfigured humans have hidden themselves — and they'll do anything to keep it that way.
Investigating a lethal virus, Peter & Olivia become isolated inside a quarantined building and face life-threatening circumstances — while the rest of the team tries to save them.
Investigating a lethal toxin that was unleashed on a wedding ceremony as a weaponized experiment, Walter uncovers an alarming formula that reveals a link to the Bishop family tree.
When a violent tremor shakes a Manhattan office building and only one survivor is found, Walter surmises that its cause is rooted in his research with William Bell many years ago.
While explaining Peter's otherworldly origins to Olivia, Walter flashes back to 1985 where Peter's mother (guest star ORLA BRADY) is introduced.

programmes.st: Olivia. In the Lab. With the Revolver.
programmes.d: When a healthy woman is found dead from a disease she never had, the Fringe team investigates the origin of this inexplicably fatal condition before it claims more lives.
When passengers aboard a commuter train are found completely drained of power, the Fringe Team investigates another bizarre case with deadly consequences.

programmes.st: The Man from the Other Side
programmes.d: Thomas Jerome Newton is back — and so is evidence of the alternate world's shapeshifters. Peter reveals a family secret while Walter struggles to discern Newton's motives.
While Walter deals with some very upsetting news — he tells Olivia's niece, Ella (LILY PILBLAD), a fairy tale that includes musical performances by Olivia and Agent Broyles.
Peter teams up with a local law enforcement official on a serial murder investigation with ties to Newton. And someone from the "other side" pays a visit.
Walter and Olivia venture into the alternate world for the anticipated face-off with William Bell (special guest star LEONARD NIMOY) in the first of a two-part season finale.
The universes may never be the same on the Season 2 Finale!
In the Season Three premiere, a disoriented Olivia fights to find her way home, while Peter and Walter try to move on with their lives — unknowingly alongside the alternate Olivia.
Humans have always used their best technology to save lives.
Green technology is radically changing the way people get around.
High tech is bringing fossils, artwork and historical artifacts to classrooms around the world.
Inventors are up to some crazy things.
Chuck Pell visits a lab where vaccines are developed inside of plants and then processed into pills.
We have always been interested in the workings of Earth, and high tech is giving them new insights.
This lab creates a blistering desert one minute and a tropical rain forest the next.
We now know how many trees are on Earth and, almost in real-time, can tell who’s cutting them down.

War is the driving force behind much of the innovation in the 1940s.  The microwave is born after a self-taught inventor realizes that military equipment is responsible for melting a chocolate bar in his pocket.
The 1950s heralds the end of vacuum tubes and the rise of mobile technologies when two Japanese inventors shrink cabinet-size radios down to something small enough to fit in your pocket.
The 1960s is a decade of both cultural and technological change.  Home entertainment goes from the kitchen table to the TV screen when the video game console is unveiled.
The cell phone moves from the car console to the hand when an engineer is inspired by a science fiction series.  The hybrid car is reborn as an answer to the concerns over fossil fuels.
Humans refine and evolve weapons designs over the millennia to gain the upper hand.
Pioneering breakthroughs from across the globe shape the ability to travel.
The first data-recording device from over 5,000 years ago; how weaving creates binary code.
From living in caves to grand mansions, shelter has always been high on the list of priorities.

The Rockies. Magnificent and awe-inspiring mysterious, the Rockies are one of the longest mountain ranges in the world. Naked Science investigates the geological processes that build these massive mountains.

programmes.st: How To Avert an Asteroid Impact
programmes.d: Throughout history, the earth has been bombarded from space. Asteroid impacts have caused mass extinctions – including the dinosaur wipe out.
Naked Science investigates the violent cosmological forces that create planets and discover what it is that makes a planet a planet.

Gravity keeps us on the ground and the planets in their orbits, yet we only notice it when it's not there. In space we cheat gravity; falling just as fast but missing the ground. Now this fundamental universal force is slowly giving up its secrets.
Burned out on dating and ready to quit, Leah takes her eccentric grandma's outrageous challenge—40 dates in 40 nights for a full year of paid rent.
An eccentric dad dresses as a British nanny to care for his kids at their mother's home.

In 1776, South Carolina widower and legendary war hero Benjamin Martin (Mel Gibson) finds himself thrust into the midst of the American Revolutionary War as he helplessly watches his family torn apart by the savage British Redcoats.

An eccentric dad dresses as a British nanny to care for his kids at their mother's home.
Miami cops Will Smith and Martin Lawrence are two loose cannons who tear up the Sunshine State in search of stolen drugs. Co-starring Tea Leoni. Explosive direction by Michael Bay (Armageddon).

The action and comedy never stop when Martin Lawrence and Will Smith reunite as out-of-control, trash-talking buddy cops. Bullets fly, cars crash, and laughs explode as they pursue a whacked-out drug lord from the streets of Miami to the barrios of Cuba.

When three close friends escape from Hong Kong to war-time Saigon to start a criminal's life, they all go through a harrowing experience which totally shatters their lives and their friendship forever.
A tough-as-nails cop teams up with an undercover agent to shut down a sinister mobster and his crew.
In this Robert Rodriguez/Quentin Tarantino tribute to ’70s exploitation films, a go-go dancer kills zombies in Planet Terror, and a stuntman stalks and kills women in Death Proof.

In this thrilling cult classic, two dangerous outlaw brothers head out on a wild crime spree. After kidnapping a father and his two kids, the bad guys head to a seedy Mexican bar for safety, but come face to face with blood-sucking vampires.
In these intertwined tales, a universe of unlikely and reluctant heroes try to do the right thing in a city that refuses to care.
In the future, a division of the police department has the technology to arrest killers before they commit crimes; however, the tables turn on one of the cops working within the division.
When mysterious spacecraft touch down across the globe, an elite team - led by expert translator Louise Banks (Academy Award® nominee Amy Adams) – races against time to decipher their intent.

programmes.t: Friday the 13th Part - IV: The Final Chapter
programmes.d: After his revival in a hospital morgue, the hockey-masked murderer fixes his vengeful attention on the Jarvis family and a group of hitherto carefree teenagers.

programmes.t: Friday the 13th Part V: A New Beginning
programmes.d: This time, he seems to have set his sights on the young patients at a secluded halfway house. And more than a few of his teen targets end up in half, in quarters... You name it, Jason does it.

programmes.t: Friday the 13th, Part VI: Jason Lives
programmes.d: As a child, Tommy Jarvis did what many others died trying to do. He killed Jason Vorhees, the mass murderer who terrorized the residents of Crystal Lake. But now, years later, Tommy is tormented by the fear that maybe Jason isn’t really dead.

programmes.t: Friday the 13th Part VII: The New Blood
programmes.d: Ever since homicidal maniac Jason Voorhees got trapped in chains at the bottom of Crystal Lake, the nearby summer camp has operated without a hitch... without a murder. But one of this season’s happy campers has brought along a deadly secret.

programmes.t: Friday the 13th Part VIII: Jason Takes Manhattan
programmes.d: The Big Apple’s in big trouble, as indestructible psycho-fiend Jason Voorhees hits the road to New York City - and paints the town “red.”

65 years after a masked serial killer terrorized the small town of Texarkana, the "moonlight murders" begin again. A lonely high school girl, with dark secrets of her own, may be the key to catching him.
A young woman inherits an isolated mansion from a distant relative, but an unspeakable horror awaits her in the mansion's dank cellars.
To Jill Johnson, it was the perfect babysitting job. The parents were away. The fridge was stocked. The children were tucked into bed. Rated: PG-13
Haunted by terrifying visions, Sarah's sleepwalking episodes begin to intensify, accelerating her descent into darkness.

Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

BLUE RUIN is a classic American revenge story, following a mysterious outsider whose quiet life is turned upside down when he returns to his childhood home, determined to carry out an act of vengeance.
Jake Gyllenhaal stars in this action thriller about a man who awakens in another man’s body to discover only he has the ability to stop a terrorist attack on a commuter train.
Based on Robert Graysmith's books about the real-life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.
Leonardo Di Caprio and Academy Award winner Russell Crowe star in director Ridley Scott's adaptation of the best-selling post-9/11 espionage thriller.
A detached man and his friend organize brutal, bare-knuckle boxing matches.
Academy Award nominees Leonardo DiCaprio and Djimon Hounsou join Academy Award winner Jennifer Connelly in this action drama from Ed Zwick, the filmmaker behind The Last Samurai.

When a deadly sniper terrorizes the DC area for weeks, frantic police put out an APB for a white van.
When a young man is murdered in his home, the only suspect with a motive is his ex-girlfriend, who claims she hasn’t seen the victim for months.

programmes.d: When an aspiring actress is found dead in the home of a legendary music producer, he claims it was suicide.

Rodney Alcala appeared on The Dating Game and it led to his arrest. In 2011, he was found guilty of murdering six women and a twelve-year-old girl.
In August 1985, the fourteen-month killing spree of Richard Ramirez, known as the 'Night Stalker,' was ended after he claimed at least thirteen lives.
Serial killing partners Leonard Lake and Charles Ng murdered eleven people in California in the 1980s. They had a secret bunker where they raped and killed their prey.
The Sunderland Strangler, Steven Grieveson, killed four teenage boys in the early 90s.
Railway Killers John Duffy and David Mulcahy killed three women and raped many more across a four-year period in the early 1980s.
When Jennifer Cave fails to show up at her new job, her family fears the worst. Unfortunately, their fears are confirmed when they take their search for her into their own hands.
Prominent community leaders from a metro Washington D.C. neighborhood are murdered when they answer a knock at their front door.
A mother of two goes missing after the second day of the family's vacation cruise. Following a lengthy investigation, police point their finger at the husband. What really happened?

After a wild night on a party cruise, a young, beautiful, aspiring actress is found dead, but the circumstances around her death are as mysterious as they are tragic. Could her boyfriend know more than he's saying?
In 1999, California handyman Cary Staynor raped and murdered four young women. Obsessed with Big Foot, he became the monster in the woods.
Edmund Kemper killed ten people: his grandparents, six co-eds, his mother, and his mother's friend. He was caught in California in 1973 and confessed it all.
In December 2015, Horst Kroner boarded a plane. He had brutally murdered his wife while she slept and was now headed to Thailand for easy sex.
Random shootings, rapes, and robberies leave almost all of the residents of Phoenix, Arizona scared.
On an unusually warm September morning beloved yoga instructor Michael Dojaquez is found shot dead on his front porch.
Marc Despain is discovered by his wife Michelle, shot dead in his kitchen with the house made to look like it had been burglarized.
Tireless nurse Bonnie Woodward would never simply disappear and leave her family behind - that's not the type of person she was.
Apart, a woman and a man can be innocent, safe to society.

There's action galore in this off-beat western that features a group of mostly black infantrymen who return from the Spanish-American War with a cache of gold. The men travel to the West where their leader searches for the men who lynched his father.

In 1908, Chief (Mario Van Peebles) returns from years of hiding to claim stolen gold. In his quest, he reunites an ensemble of familiar faces. Together, they fight off Angel, whose desire for the gold leaves a trail of dead bodies.

Two travelers, on the run from a band of vengeful hunters in the 1820s Northwest, dream of striking it rich—but their tenuous plan to make their fortune on the frontier comes to rely on the secret use of a landowner's prized dairy cow.

The Old West becomes a battleground for power and revenge in this gripping epic based on true events. A young Chinese woman, Ying-Ying, finds herself on a boat to America after escaping the clutches of a bad arranged marriage.
Settlers traveling through the Oregon desert in 1845 find themselves stranded in harsh conditions.
A woman asks her ex-lover for help to save her outlaw husband from a gang out to kill him.
True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

Director Antoine Fuqua brings his modern vision to the classic western, a story of seven outlaws who join together to save a town from an evil industrialist! Denzel Washington, Chris Pratt, Ethan Hawke and Vincent D'Onofrio and Peter Sarsgaard star!

Jane tries to raise money by selling artwork, Trent has a hard time delegating, and the Fashion Club seeks legal counsel.
Daria feels apprehensive about inviting Tom to a dinner with her parents, and Quinn has unrealistic expectations when she decides she wants a steady boyfriend.
Daria and Jane's friendship is tested when Jane dates an opinionated guy with a love for everything vintage, and Upchuck tries his hand at magic.
Helen agrees to help her niece with her divorce, Jake leaves home to escape Helen and Aunt Rita's bickering, Daria avoids Tom, and Stacy and Tiffany face a fashion dilemma.
Daria has mixed feelings when she applies for a scholarship sponsored by a company known for unethical business practices, and Jane resents the scholarship process.

Jenna competes with Matty's new girlfriend as they plan his surprise 18th birthday party, and Sadie and Tamara face off when Lissa is suspended and can't lead the cheerleading squad.

The  Silverwood  Family  hit  some stormy  weather  180  miles  west  of  Bora  Borain  the  South  Pacific.
Charlie  Hench has  set  himself  a  big  challenge  before  he  turns  the  big  50.
Trainee pilot Justin Kirkbride takes two friends on a sightseeing tour of the Rocky  Mountains.

programmes.st: Death in the Sea of Cortez
programmes.d: Lifelong  friends  Joseph  Rangel  and Lorenzo  Madrid sign  up  for  a  five-day sport fishing trip.
Steven Callahan departs from El Hierro in the Canary Islands. One night a ferocious storm damages  his boat.
Tom and Sean face off against a coyote threat; Eustace and Raleigh enlist some much-needed help building their lookout cabin; Jason takes one final crack at creating Ozark steel.
Tom turns coyotes into cash; Eustace and Raleigh take to the forge to raise money for roofing materials; Mike scouts bears for the spring hunting season.
Jake hunts a lion caught stalking a school bus stop; Tom sets out to end his trapping season on a high note; Eustace and Raleigh struggle to put a roof on their outpost cabin.
Tom builds an authentic Native American bull boat; Jake goes back on the hunt for the bus stop bandit; Morgan struggles to haul a ton of greenhouse supplies.
Ten new participants confront the most grueling challenge, facing a variety of predators is the first hurdle they must overcome.
Philippine locals come to the aid of the expedition. The men receive unexpected help at Noa Noa Island. Every last drop of fuel is filtered. The crew finds a remote cemetery.

programmes.st: Up In Smoke And Going Broke
programmes.d: While shipping an 11-foot-tall glass water pipe to the Mile-High City, Marc tries to mellow out after a blown tire threatens to turn this shipment into shards.
When tasked with hauling the old animatronic band, Rock-A-Fire Explosion, Jenn ends up pulling a Yoko Ono and almost cancels their reunion tour.

Team Salvage has been called in to rescue a stranded vessel stuck in a mangrove jungle in North Queensland. It got blown in there by Cyclone Debbie. The only way they can get it out is to winch it out. But there’s a problem.
Team Salvage is trying to re-float a damaged yacht. The owners want to keep it and get it repaired. The squad successfully winches it out only to discover it’s leaking and is full of toxic fumes.
Vintage Shooting Star carnival game; professional Mixed Martial Arts octagon fighting cage.
Mint 1800s French "Harmonica Pistol" and a collection of '90s remote-controlled combat robots.
'70s sand rail dune racer with rally hemi heads; 1965 replica Mustang pool table; off-road racing gear.
1970's-era Fighting Chair used for big-game fishing; military MILES "laser tag" training system.

programmes.st: Three Kennys Are Worse Than None
programmes.d: Paul and Bogart arrive at an auction with a new “secret weapon:” Paul's inexperienced brother Barry.

Roy shows his nephew what being an instigator is all about at an auction in South Etobicoke. Bogart wants a new catch-phrase. Rick's pirate shtick grates on Cindy's nerves, but that's nothing compared to what they get from director Kenny Hotz.

Bogart's hooked on goji berry juice and plans to spread the word at an auction in Milton. Roy is in all white, looking to spread distraction. Cindy's mind is on the lockers, but Rick's is in the gutter. Ursula has a bonsai to pick with her locker.

Roy distracts other buyers by invading their personal space at an auction in Mississauga. Paul and Bogart are clueless at finding a gift for Bogart's fiancée. Rick and Cindy regret arriving on rollerblades and Ursula has a horrific hair day.

Roy makes mischief at an auction in Toronto with an assortment of classic pranks. Rick and Cindy resort to flashing to grab Don's attention. Ursula vows to take the perfect selfie, and Paul decides Bogart is finally ready for “the talk."

The bachelor party Roy has planned for Bogart is all anyone can talk about. Before the party can begin, Paul and Bogart take care of some adorable business and Rick and Cindy hope to make some money at the track when they meet up with an Olympian.

New buyer Tommy is larger than life and looking for a big score at an auction in Brampton. Roy arrives with an intern, eager to mentor for free labor. Rick and Cindy hedge their bets and Ursula would rather be shopping.

programmes.st: Honeymoon Capital Of The Storage World
programmes.d: The buyers attend an auction in Niagara Falls. Rick and Cindy wonder if Cindy will be recognized in her old hometown. Ursula is in a sticky situation, Roy is better off undead, and Paul and Bogart visit the Ripley's Believe It or Not! Museum.

programmes.st: You Scratch My Back And I’ll Scratch Yours
programmes.d: The salvage game is all about you scratch my back and I’ll scratch yours. The crew is towing a damaged yacht to a North Queensland boatyard. The vessel has a broken keel, no steering capacity and it’s taking on water.

Team Salvage is in the middle of a major beach rescue. But things are not looking good. Christopher the winch beast is bogged, their maintenance van is bogged and the excavator they brought in to toe Christopher out is also bogged.

While the discovery of a possible slipway in the swamp reinforces the team's eagerness to excavate further, the fellowship is shocked when they learn Zena's map may have been pointing to the elusive Treasure Vault the entire time.
Further excavation uncovers more evidence that the stone structure in the swamp could be a roadway, and analysis of the serpent mound has it dating back to the Templars.
Rick, Marty and the team are astonished when they realize the mysterious stone roadway in the swamp may be heading directly towards the Money Pit.
Digging deeper than ever before, the Laginas and their team find evidence of previously unknown structures in the Money Pit. While in the swamp, Gary strikes gold.
While searching the spoils excavated from the Money Pit area, Alex Lagina discovers evidence of human activity deep underground, dating back to 1492.
Rare 1950s Master Pitch baseball machine; 1980s Jaws of Life tool used by rescuers to pry open cars.
Kirk investigates a planet with an Earth-like 1920's gangster culture.
The Enterprise encounters a gigantic energy draining space organism that threatens the galaxy.
Kirk becomes involved in an arms race when the Klingons equip a native people with superior weaponry.
The U.S.S. Enterprise tracks a mysterious SOS to an ancient planet presumed long dead.
Enterprise is sent to planet Ekos to investigate a disappearance of Federation historian John Gill.
The Enterprise's command crew must thwart an invasion by aliens from another galaxy who plan to conquer this one.
The Enterprise finds a planet devastated by disease that appears to treat the American flag with great reverence.
Starfleet uses the Enterprise to test a new super-sophisticated computer, but it soon develops a mind of its own.
The Enterprise crew investigates the disappearance of a ship's crew on a planet that is a modern version of the Roman Empire.
Kirk must decide whether to thwart or help a traveller from the future sent back to 1960s Earth on a secret mission.
The crew of the Enterprise pursues a mysterious woman who has abducted Spock's brain.
Captain Kirk becomes increasingly erratic and orders the Enterprise into Romulan space. Here, the ship is captured by a beautiful Romulan commander.
Kirk loses his memory and is proclaimed a God while trapped on a planet whose inhabitants are descended from Northwestern Native Americans.
The Enterprise reaches a Federation colony where the adults have all killed themselves but the children play without care.

programmes.st: Is There In Truth No Beauty?
programmes.d: Miranda Jones, a telepath who studied mental disciplines on Vulcan, arrives with Ambassador Kolos, a Medusan.
When coming to a xenophobic isolationist planet, Captain Kirk and his landing party are punished for trespassing.
When the Enterprise brings aboard Klingon prisoners, an alien entity pits both sides against each other in an ever-escalating struggle.
Stranded on a desolate planet, longtime adversaries Odo and Quark must rely on each other to survive.
Sisko is plagued by life-threatening visions that may hold the key to Bajor's future.
A mysterious assassin targets the members of Kira's resistance cell for execution.
While Kira gives birth, Odo raises an infant, Changeling.
Sisko risks everything to capture a former crewmember who deceived him and joined the Maquis.
While Worf and Garak are imprisoned in the Gamma Quadrant, Sisko learns of a Dominion invasion.
Led by Gul Dukat, Cardassia joins the Dominion and prepares to take over the Alpha Quadrant.
When Bashir is chosen as the model for Starfleet's holographic doctor program, the process threatens to expose a dark secret from his past.
Odo falls in love with a mysterious woman who has been targeted for murder.
Quark accepts a position working for an arms dealer to erase his debts.
The imminent death of Kira's Cardassian "father" rekindles painful memories of losing her real father.
Quark sacrifices his mother's happiness to regain his standing in Ferengi society.
On a mission for the Klingon Empire, Worf realizes that his friend General Martok is no longer fit to lead.
Sisko and the Defiant crew must choose between the lives they have always known and the lives of their own descendants.
Sisko attempts to force his traitorous former officer to stop a final Maquis attack that could lead to the destruction of the Federation.
O'Brien, Garak, Nog, and a salvage team are stranded on a supposedly abandoned Cardassian space station.
Jake and Nog risk an intergalactic incident in an innocent quest to lift Sisko's spirits.

Archer, T'Pol and T'Pau attempt to bring the Kir'Shara an artifact believed to contain Surak's original writings  to the Vulcan capital, as the NX-01 gets involved in a Vulcan-Andorian military clash.
The inventor of the transporter, Emory Erickson, comes aboard Enterprise for a risky experiment.
Noncorporeal aliens study the Enterprise crew as they respond to a fatal viral infection brought on board from an away mission.
Enterprise journeys to Babel with a Tellarite ambassador on board for peace talks with the Andorians, when a distress call from Shran is received.
Archer tries to unify the Andorians, Tellarites and Vulcans in a plan to capture a marauder ship threatening to destabilize the region.
Archer visits Shran's icy homeworld to find an Andorian subspecies called the Aenar, to determine their connection to the marauder destroying ships in the region.
While Enterprise visits Earth for the launch of Columbia, Phlox is kidnapped and forced to help the Klingons deal with a grave threat toward their species.
With Columbia's help, the Enterprise crew grapples with sabotage to their ship as they pursue the truth behind the kidnapping of Phlox.
As a gift for negotiating with the Orion Syndicate, Captain Archer receives three Orion Slave Girls.
In the mirror universe, Commander Archer mutinies against Captain Forrest in order to capture a future Earth ship found in Tholian space.

programmes.st: In a Mirror, Darkly, Part II
programmes.d: In the mirror universe, Archer commandeers the 23rd-century Defiant from the Tholians and uses it in a nefarious power grab.
A xenophobic faction of humanity threatens to undermine talks to form a new coalition of planets.
A human isolationist leader threatens to destroy Starfleet Command unless all aliens leave Earth immediately.
Six years in the future, an emotional Captain Archer and the crew return to Earth to face the decommission of Enterprise and signing of the Federation charter.

The maiden crew of the starship Enterprise seizes the long overdue opportunity to gain independence for Humans from the Vulcans by venturing into untracked space to deliver a Klingon messenger to his home world of Kronos.

The maiden crew of the starship Enterprise seizes the long overdue opportunity to gain independence for Humans from the Vulcans by venturing into untracked space to deliver a Klingon messenger to his home world of Kronos.

Archer must choose between the safety of his crew and doing the right thing as the vulnerable Enterprise must survive while trying to uphold justice between two different unknown alien ships in battle.

When a ruthless mastermind, Khan (Benedict Cumberbatch), declares a one-man war on the Federation, Captain Kirk (Chris Pine), Spock (Zachary Quinto), and the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise set out on their most explosive manhunt of all time.

On a rescue mission, the USS Enterprise is attacked by Krall, a warlord sworn against the Federation. Crashed on an uncharted world, the crew must join forces with Jaylah, a rebellious alien warrior, to escape and stop Krall from triggering all-out war.
The greatest adventure of all time begins with Star Trek, the incredible story of a young crew's maiden voyage onboard the most advanced starship ever created: the U.S.S. Enterprise.

When a ruthless mastermind, Khan (Benedict Cumberbatch), declares a one-man war on the Federation, Captain Kirk (Chris Pine), Spock (Zachary Quinto), and the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise set out on their most explosive manhunt of all time.

On a rescue mission, the USS Enterprise is attacked by Krall, a warlord sworn against the Federation. Crashed on an uncharted world, the crew must join forces with Jaylah, a rebellious alien warrior, to escape and stop Krall from triggering all-out war.
Kirk meets Khan, a notorious dictator, and leader of Earth's Eugenics War.

programmes.t: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programmes.d: 23rd century: The Federation Starship U.S.S. Enterprise™ is on routine training maneuvers, and Admiral James T. Kirk seems resigned to the fact that this inspection may well be the last space mission of his career. But Khan is back...
Picard learns that he has a son, and that the young man has been targeted for murder by an old enemy in search of revenge.
The lives of the Enterprise crew are endangered when the ship suddenly develops its own intelligence.
Ro Laren is forced to choose between her loyalty to Picard and her hatred toward Cardassia when she accepts an assignment to infiltrate the Maquis.
Picard finds himself travelling between the past, present, and future while attempting to prevent the destruction of humanity... by his own actions.
The Enterprise is carrying an eminent scientist, Dr. Paul Stubbs, to the site of a binary star where they are expecting a massive stellar explosion to occur in a few hours.
After a century of silence, the Enterprise receives a message from the Sheliac system informing them that they have discovered a human colony on a world in their sector.
The Enterprise responds to a distress call from Rana IV, a Federation colony that is under attack from an unknown alien ship.
A proto-Vulcan culture worships Captain Picard and prepares to offer Counselor Troi as a sacrifice.
A startling surprise awaits the crew of the Enterprise when a mission costs the life of a crew member, who left her son behind.

The Enterprise picks up ancient radio signal code from the ruined planet Aurelius 9, remnants of the total war over 1,000 years ago between Mentaurs and Promelians which caused both races' extinction.
LaForge gets left behind on a storm-plagued planet when the rest of his team encounters a Romulan warrior.
While the Enterprise hosts negotiations for control of a stable wormhole, Troi forms a personal relationship with an opposing negotiator, unaware of his true being.
The Enterprise pursues a race of "gatherers" who continue to raid Federation outposts, unaware of the dangers lurking among them.
When a Romulan officer defects to the Federation with a warning of an impending invasion, Capt. Picard struggles to decide if he is to be believed.
Investigating a planet applying for membership into the Federation, the crew of the Enterprise finds a group of inhabitants who used to be soldiers but now fight for their very existence.
While visiting a planet under civil war, Dr. Crusher is taken hostage by an opposing faction of the planet's ruling government.
Janeway's actions could cost the crew their chance of reaching home.
The pupil becomes the teacher when a Borg drone is born on Voyager and Seven of Nine instructs him in the ways of humanity.
A need to test herself leads Torres down a path of self-destruction.
The Voyager crew discovers an alien training ground for the destruction of Earth.
Neelix balks at telling Naomi that her mother and others have gone missing on an away mission.
Fifteen years after making a horrible mistake, Kim attempts to rewrite history.
Seven experiences the Borg version of multiple personality disorder.
Torres is forced to put her life in the hands of a mortal enemy that uses biochemical secretions to give commands.
Paris is confined to the Brig after interfering with the affairs of an alien race.
Janeway falls for a man who may be using her to take over Voyager.
Someone is trying to keep the Doctor from remembering the incidents surrounding a crewmember's death.
Janeway and Paris join forces to defeat the evil Doctor Chaotica.
Stranded on a desolate planet with a beautiful female, Tuvok struggles to ignore the emotions his Vulcan master taught him to suppress.
The crew is in serious danger when all of their dreams seem to come true and home seems closer in sight.
During a mission against the Borg, Seven of Nine is lured back to the Collective.
When Seven is threatened by assimilation into the Collective, Janeway launches an all-out mission to rescue her.
Kim puts his future with Voyager at risk when he chooses love over duty.

Wanting to maintain diplomatic relations, Sheppard and McKay accompany Harmony, a precocious young princess, on a mandatory rite of passage. However, they are unaware that she has enemies, and character flaws, yet to be dealt with.

When Lt. Colonel John Sheppard receives word that his father has passed away he returns to Earth. But once there, he becomes embroiled in a dangerous experiment gone awry—a human form Replicator now on the loose that must be recaptured at all cost.

During an off-world mission in a village rocked by fierce tremors, Col. Samantha Carter, Dr. McKay, and Dr. Keller become trapped when they fall into a sinkhole. But every attempt to escape the confines of the chamber puts them in further jeopardy.

While exploring a new planet, Lt. Scott is attacked by an aggressive plant-like creature that infects him. Scott's circumstances turn dire and Tamara must search for a way to stop the alien infection from spreading while more creatures move in.

Col. Young (Louis Ferreira) is plagued by a recurring vision wherein Destiny is attacked and destroyed by aliens. After placing the crew on high alert, he starts to feel that he may be losing his mind and questions his ability as the commander!

When Destiny comes upon a heavily damaged ship, Dr. Rush and Col. Young decide to make a dangerous space-suited expedition to the ship. But an unexpected turn of events leaves Dr. Rush and Col. Young stranded aboard the strange vessel.

Lucian Alliance prisoner Simeon escapes, creating a manhunt on a remote planet. But Homeworld Command orders he be captured alive, believing Simeon has valuable information. Simeon must be brought back to the Destiny before he kills or is killed.

An experiment goes wrong leaving Lt. Colonel Samantha Carter (Amanda Tapping) trapped in a parallel reality where martial law has been enforced and Earth is under attack from the Ori. Also starring Ben Browder, Christopher Judge, and Michael Shanks.

When Daniel Jackson turns up as a Prior asking SG-1 to aid him in a plan that might very well be a trap, it's up to Maj. Gen. Jack O'Neill and the team to not only save Jackson's life, but possibly end the war with the Ori once and for all.

After Netan (Eric Steinberg), and the Lucian Alliance, are undermined by SG-1 yet again, he decides to put a bounty out on their heads. Starring Ben Browder, Amanda Tapping, Christopher Judge, Claudia Black, Beau Bridges, and Michael Shanks.

Mistaken for rebels on an alien planet, SG-1 must play the part of hostage takers in hopes to buy themselves enough time to be rescued before they're executed. Starring Ben Browder, Amanda Tapping, Christopher Judge, and Michael Shanks.

Barely surviving the bombing massacre of a peaceful Jaffa summit, Teal'c (Christopher Judge) must go rogue to track down and stop a Jaffa leader named Arkad (Craig Fairbrass) who plans to take control of the Jaffa nation and deliver them to the Ori.

Vala's (Claudia Black) father Jacek (guest star Fred Willard) contacts Stargate Command wishing to trade information about a series of planned attacks on Earth in exchange for sanctuary on the planet. Also starring Ben Browder and Michael Shanks.

In an elaborate plan using Vala Mal Doran (Claudia Black) as bait to capture Adria (guest star Morena Baccarin), SG-1 themselves are surprised when Ba'al (guest star Cliff Simon) intercepts Adria from under them to use in his own evil plan.

With extinction imminent, the Asgard hand over all their knowledge and technology to SG-1, but not before the Ori launch an attack trying to intercede. Starring Ben Browder, Amanda Tapping, Christopher Judge, Beau Bridges, and Michael Shanks.

As Colonel Jack O'Neill and his team journey to Abydos to confront deadly warriors and laser-firing Death Gliders, O'Neill realizes that this new mission seems hauntingly familiar and that an old enemy has returned to take his revenge on Earth.

It’s a retelling of 'Sleeping Beauty' – but our focus is on the fairy that didn’t get her invitation and stubbornly refuses to listen to the reason why.
This is the story of 'Rapunzel', but with a twist.  Princess Rapunzel (Rainbow Sherbet) has always preferred being called Rap and liked doing things her way.
Strawberry Shortcake’s childhood friend, Lime Lite, has hit it big in Berrywood, movie capital of Strawberryland.
When Strawberryland’s one movie theatre goes out of business, Strawberry has an idea to save it: she and her friends can film a movie to show there and attract crowds back to the theatre.
Strawberry Shortcake is planning a first birthday party for her sister Apple Dumpling, so she sets off on an adventure to find the perfect party supplies.
It’s the first day of spring in Strawberryland, at least it’s supposed to be, but with the cold winds blowing and frost on the ground it looks as though spring isn’t going to come this year.
Honey Pie Pony hurts her leg and must stay in bed instead of heading off for a grand adventure.
Strawberry’s cat Custard is shown to live a pampered, adored existence in Strawberry’s house. But Custard’s dream set-up is shattered by the sudden arrival of a rambunctious stray puppy.
Conniving Peppermint Fizz talks the other kids into a competition to see whose pet is best. Peppermint cheats so that her pet, Cola Chameleon, wins best pet.
Honey Pie Pony is feeling left out of all the kids’ play.  She’s the only one with four legs.  There’s no one like her to talk to and share her feelings.
Honey Pie Pony is excited that the ponies of Ice Cream Island have invited her to take part in their annual Festival of the Horses.
Angel Cake likes everything 'just so' — and when things don’t go her way, she’s a pretty bad sport.
Peppermint Fizz is so determined to win the Nearly Once-A-Yearly Strawberryland Games.

programmes.st: Ginger Snap’s No-Light Night of Fright
programmes.d: When Strawberry & Friends go on an overnight campout, Ginger Snap doesn’t want them to find out, she’s afraid of the dark!
There’s someone…or something strange in the neighborhood, and the kids imagine the worst.
Strawberry is made to feel self-conscious about an old, patched-together raincoat that she has.
Peppermint Fizz wants to exclude a new girl, Blueberry Muffin, because she’s 'different' – in the way she looks, lives, talks, etc.
Strawberry’s friend Coco Calypso lives on Seaberry Beach with her pet, Papaya Parrot, and a band of fun-loving monkeys.
A fantasy episode in which Strawberry, Rainbow Sherbet, Blueberry Muffin, Coco Calypso, and Seaberry Delight imagine themselves as Mermaids, drawn into a grand adventure.
Strawberry Shortcake’s friendship letter to children worldwide elicits Crepes Suzette's invitation to visit Pearis and the Pieffel Tower.
Friends from all over the world descend on Strawberryland to take part in the first Great Friendship Festival.

programmes.st: When the Berry Fairy Came to Stay
programmes.d: Out gathering berries one day, Strawberry & her pets find a tiny fairy among the berry vines.
One windy day, a tiny fairy named Sherry Bobbleberry gets blown into Strawberry’s open window.
Apple Dumplin’ wants to help Strawberry & her Friends with the baking.  But Dumplin’s just a little too little to be much help.  In fact, she ends up making a pretty big mess of things.
At the urging of Honey Pie Pony, Strawberry & Friends decide to put on a Cooking Show.
It’s that time of year when the berries are about to burst into bloom – and it looks like this will be a bumper crop!
The Berry Blossom Festival is underway and everyone in Strawberryland is having a Grand Time, thanks to the selfless efforts of Strawberry Shortcake.
Strawberry and her friends love to dance – and the Peculiar Purple Pieman of Porcupine Peak is taking advantage of that!
It’s winter and the pond’s frozen and that means Strawberry and friends can ice skate!
When Strawberry & her friends decide to put on a talent show, they plan to enter themselves as a band called Strawberry Jams
Strawberry and her friends are getting the band back together to perform at a local festival, but Ginger Snap is out of town.
Strawberry Shortcake has always dreamed of seeing a certain rare flower, which only blooms once every ten years – and then only for a day!
After an accidental wager with Purple Pieman, Strawberry sets off to prove that she can go around the world in 80 days.
One night, as Strawberry & Friends gaze at the stars, they talk about what they want to be when they grow up.
The season's opilio crab tally is in, and a winner is declared.
The fleet sets off to brave the deadly Bering Sea and cash in on king crab.
The Time Bandit pulls a prank on the Cornelia Marie.

programmes.st: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programmes.d: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions.  Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract.  The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programmes.st: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programmes.d: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house.  Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programmes.st: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programmes.d: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house.  While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programmes.st: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programmes.d: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programmes.st: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programmes.d: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo.  Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room.  Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum.  The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up).  Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector.  Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums.  When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programmes.st: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programmes.d: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters.  In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey.  Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway.  When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic.  Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programmes.st: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programmes.d: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room.  They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met.  In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story.  Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden.  Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch.  Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

A famous gunfighter marries and decides to retire. He and his wife settle down in North Fork and open a store, but three outlaws arrive in town looking to best him in a gunfight.
An old friend of Lucas McCain's, a traveling photographer, comes to North Fork plying his trade. When a murder is committed, the photographer is accused of the crime.
The townsfolk of North Fork decide to give a young couple a shivaree celebration. When the drunken crowd gets out of hand and roughs up the bride-to-be, the young groom challenges them.
When a young boy from Brooklyn is accused of murder, Mark, believing the boy's claim of innocence, hides him until he can find the real killer.
U.S. Marshal Sam Buckhart arrives in North Fork in search of renegade Indians suspected of the brutal killing of a Texas Ranger and his family.
Sid Fallon tries to blackmail former gambler Julia Andueza into allowing him to use her boarding house as a gambling hall and saloon.
Lucas puts his life in jeopardy when he agrees to testify in a murder case where the first witness was killed before he could testify, and the killer is still at large.
Outlaw Sam Morley falls in love with a young woman who has a serious illness and asks Lucas to turn him in for the reward and use the money to pay for her medical care.
Lucas welcomes his old friend Tom Birch, who once saved his life, unaware that the man is now a bank robber on the run with his gang.
Dan Maury, released from Yuma prison, arrives in North Fork intent on getting even with Marshal Torrance, who helped send him to jail.
Young Mark McCain is eager to help lawman Jay Jefferson, who has arrived in North Fork intent on killing an outlaw for the reward, whether he is the right man or not.
Lucas comes to the rescue when escaped convicts hold up the general store in North Fork and take Marshall Torrance hostage.
Young Mark manages to capture a hawk but falls into danger with a rattlesnake. A stranger comes to his rescue and Mark invites the man home, unaware that he is on the run from the law.
Lucas takes in an orphaned teen being raised by his abusive uncle after there is trouble at the school.
The McCains try to be tolerant of their embittered neighbor Abel MacDonald, but they decide he's gone too far when he won't allow his injured boy to get medical treatment.
An unfounded rumor causes North Fork's outspoken feminist schoolteacher to be attacked by a mob of angry townspeople.
When his employer begins to suspect him of embezzlement, bookkeeper Asa Manning decides to hire a professional gunman to take care of the problem.
A drought has forced local cowhands to seek work on a railroad construction project, but executives are afraid workers will desert them if they believe an old man's claim of making rain.
Lucas McCain gives blood to save a dying man and is surprised by Marshall Torrance's odd behavior towards him. Soon, men arrive from a nearby town and demand custody of the man.
When Mark finds of the body of a murder victim, Lucas, his friend Artemus and Marshall Torrance begin a search for the killer.
When renegade Apaches wound Lucas and kidnap Mark, Marshall Torrance joins with U.S. Marshall Sam Buckhart to form a rescue posse.
Lucas is the town's representative to the railroad commission until an infamous train robber dies and leaves his ill-gotten wealth to Lucas. Lucas must clear his name.
When a rancher dies after the bank forecloses the mortgage on his property, his son blames the banker for his father's death.
When a wealthy rancher is killed, Mark suggests that they seek the aid of a mind reader to identify the murderer.
A group of outlaws devise a plan to get rid of Lucas so that they can take over the town of North Fork.
After Lucas kills a mountain man in a brawl, his father arrives in North Fork to break his other boys out of jail and take revenge on Lucas and Marshall Torrance.
Newly arrived gunslinger Al Walker throws a mammoth party at the saloon, keeping acting Marshall Ben Waller busy until Lucas is forced to intervene.
After Lucas accuses a newspaper writer's misleading articles of causing an innocent man's death, the writer begins writing articles about Lucas.
Gavin and Ezra Martin think that Lucas killed their son Clemmie while taking part in a train robbery and Lucas refuses to tell them what really happened.
Eddie's daughter causes trouble for Lucas when two strangers threaten her life after she arrives with criminal information and stolen money.
Town character Brett Conway blackmails Lucas with the knowledge that a young couple Lucas rescued is suffering from yellow fever.
Lucas and Mark are stranded in the middle of a desert with very little food or water, and after Lucas is injured, Mark becomes the only hope for their survival.
While trying to protect Banker Hamilton's gold, Mark is kidnapped and held hostage at the McCain ranch and will be killed within the hour unless Lucas cooperates.
In 1942, a German wonders why he's on the deck of a British steamship, with no memory of how he got there, and an overwhelming sense of impending doom.

A World War I flying ace flies through a mysterious cloud - and lands at a modern U.S. air base in the year 1959!
Lt. Fitzgerald has found his own special wartime hell. Looking into the faces of his men prior to battle, he has the disquieting ability to see who is about to die.
Three astronauts land on what looks like Earth 200 years before they left--only all of the people seem frozen in time.

Walter Jameson is an excellent history teacher who talks about the past as if he had lived it.
When a space exploration crashes on Mars, the surviving passenger is surprised to find that Martians are human-looking, very friendly and apparently just like us...

An eccentric loser gets a new life from his guardian angel, but there is a price to keeping it.

A scientist arranges to have his human-looking robot pitch for the struggling local baseball team.

Janet moves in with Mrs. Roper while Mr. Roper is away on business, then stews about Jack and Chrissy being alone for the night in the trio's upstairs apartment.

Chrissy, whose skills in the kitchen aren't exactly sharp, invites a gourmet to share a home-cooked dinner, then pleads with Jack to be her secret stand-in-chef.
Jack defends Chrissy's honor when a man who misunderstood her friendliness shows up at the apartment and no one knows he's a cop. Guest Star(s): James Cromwell
Only Jack knows the truth when Chrissy, Janet, and Mrs. Roper think that Stanley is fooling around with another woman.
Janet loses her cool when the groovy guy and campus Adonis of her high school shows up for a date, and Jack and Chrissy conspire to leave them alone in the apartment.
Roper's on a rampage for the rent so Jack's visiting uncle, a charming rascal, passes him a bad check.
A ruffled Helen Roper takes a cafeteria job to teach husband Stanley a lesson, but returns a wreck from the experience.
Jack, Janet, and Chrissy plot to escape a boring Christmas party alone with the Ropers because the three roommates are invited to a big bash the same night.
Jack becomes caught in a dilemma when Chrissy believes he has bought her an expensive birthday present and the gift turns out to be a surprise for Roper's wife.
Jack becomes entangled in a feud between his two roommates when Janet accuses Chrissy of stealing a handsome young executive from her.
A tiny tyke terrorizes Jack and Chrissy with the threat of tears after Janet presses them into service as inexperienced, substitute sitters.
Chrissy cranks out amateur movies of Jack and Janet, and is misled into thinking she has an "interesting" talent for film making.
All work no play makes Jack an angry boy when Janet hires him to work for her and acts like a tough boss.
When Jack, Chrissy, and Janet set out for a gourmet dinner for the Ropers - designed to stave off an expected rent hike - the " meanest" sailor from Jack's navy days arrives and wrecks the evening.
Jack is in a panic - and in the doghouse with Chrissy and Janet - when a young pregnant woman arrives at the house and names him as the father.
Jack, Chrissy, and Janet find out how far Mr. Roper's garden has gone to pot when they find some unusual plants while weeding it.

An unexpected visit from Chrissy's father, the minister, throws the kids into a panic. Jack decides to move out temporarily but Reverend Snow arrives before Jack can leave. Fumbling for an explanation, Janet blurts out that she and Jack are married.
Jack and Chrissy offer to baby-sit for Stanley Roper's parakeet in exchange for a couple of concert tickets.
A surprise birthday party for Jack is nearly spoiled when an old girlfriend turns up, ready to entice Jack back into her web. Guest Star(s): Loni Anderson
Jack lies to his girlfriend in order to keep a date with his new romantic interest.
The women in Jack's life go to a nude beach protest and run into trouble with the cops.
Curious landlord Stanley Roper sneaks a peek at an X-rated diary Chrissy is typing and suddenly gets the idea that Chrissy is in love with him.
Jack gets caught in an exasperating willpower contest with Chrissy to determine whether he can give up women for longer than she can give up food.
Mysterious phone calls and secret meetings lead Jack, Janet, and Chrissy to believe that Helen Roper is having an illicit fling with her husband's best friend.
Overprotective Janet goes into a rage when she finds Jack in the same bed with her attractive sister - who is visiting.
Jack and Janet face the danger of losing Chrissy to a fast-talking guru who dazzles her into believing her place is at his side - in a distant commune.
Jack finds himself in hot water when best friends Larry's girl says she still has a mad crush on him.
Jack and Janet are up in arms when Chrissy announces that she is leaving on an overnight business trip with her new boss.

Janet and Chrissy angrily blame Jack for sending them on a wild goose chase to a nonexistent party, never dreaming that it is the Roper's teenage house guest who wants them out of the way so she can have all to herself.
Jack and Janet are shocked as evidence mounts that Chrissy seems compelled to steal, not only from them but also from the Ropers.
Landlord Stanley Roper plays such a dirty trick on Jack, Janet, and Chrissy that his wife walks out on him.

On May 8th, 1982 Ray Mancini and Arturo Frias fought for the WBA World Lightweight title at the Aladdin in Las Vegas with what was supposed to be a 15 round bout ending in the first by technical knockout securing the victory for Ray Mancini.

On September 15th, 1983 Ray Mancini fought Orlando Romero for the WBA World Lightweight title at Madison Square Garden in New York with the bout ending in the ninth round by knockout earning Mancini the win.
On August 5th, 1990 Ray Mercer faced Bert Cooper for Heavyweight titles at the Convention Hall in Atlantic City with the bout ending by unanimous decision in favor of Mercer.

On October 18th, 1991 Ray Mercer faced Tommy Morrison for the WBO World Heavyweight titles at the Convention Center in Atlantic City ending in technical knockout by Mercer earning him the victory and title but, he relinquished the title shortly after.
On October 20th, 2018 Rob Brant faced Ryota Murata for a second time for the WBA World Middleweight title at the Park Theater in Las Vegas that ended in a unanimous decision victory for Brant.
On June 18th, 2022, Robeisy Ramirez and Abraham Nova fought for the IBF USBA & WBO Global Featherweight titles at Madison Square Garden resulting in a knockout victory for Robeisy Ramirez.

On December 12th, 2020, Robeisy Ramirez fought Brandon Valdes in a featherweight bout in The Bubble at MGM Grand in Las Vegas. Ramirez showed his impressive speed and natural power, stopping Valdes in the sixth round.
On June 16th, 1983 Roberto Duran fought Davey Moore for the WBA World Super welterweight title at Madison Square Garden in New York Moore was knocked down in the 7th round giving the win to Duran.

On February 24th, 1989, Roberto Duran fought Iran Barkley for the WBC Middleweight Title in Atlantic City. Duran, known for his relentless aggression, defeated Barkley by a close split decision in what was named The Ring Fight of the Year for 1989.
On November 12th, 1982 Roberto Duran faced Jimmy Batten at the Orange Bowl in Miami, Fl. It ended in an unanimous decision victory for Duran.

programmes.t: Roberto Duran vs Sugar Ray Leonard 1
programmes.d: On December 7th, 1989 Roberto Duran and Sugar Ray Leonard fought for the first time for the WBC World Super Middleweight at the Mirage Hotel in Las Vegas resulting in a unanimous decision win for Leonard.

programmes.t: Roman Gonzalez vs. Juan Francisco Estrada 1
programmes.d: On November 17th, 2012, Roman Gonzalez fought Juan Francisco Estrada for the WBA World Light Flyweight Title at the Sports Arena in Los Angeles. In a successful title defense fight, Gonzalez earned the unanimous decision victory.

programmes.t: Roy Jones Jr vs James Toney
programmes.d: On November 18th, 1994, Roy Jones Jr fought James Toney for the IBF Super Middleweight Title at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas. Jones displayed his exceptional athleticism and speed, outclassing Toney to win a unanimous decision victory.

programmes.t: Roy Jones Jr vs Julio Ceasar Gonzalez
programmes.d: On July 28th, 2001 Roy Jones Jr and Julio Ceasar Gonzalez battled for IBA, IBF, IBO, WBA and WBC World Light Heavyweight titles at the Staples Center in Los Angeles resulting in a win for Jones with a unanimous decsion.

programmes.t: Roy Jones Jr vs Percy Harris
programmes.d: On December 5th, 1992 Roy Jones Jr. fought Percy Harris for the WBC Continental Americas Super Middleweight title at the Trump Taj Mahal in Atlantic city with Jones defeating Harris in the 4th round by technical knockout.

programmes.t: Roy Jones Jr vs Thomas Tate
programmes.d: On May 27th, 1994 Roy Jones Jr. went up against Thomas Tate in a 12 round bout for the IBF World Middleweight title that ended in the second round by technical knockout giving Jones Jr. the win.

On July 12th, 2019 Ryota Murata participated in a rematch with Rob Brant for the WBA World Middleweight title at the EDION Arena Osaka in Japan resulting in a second round knockout securing the win for Murata.

On April 12th, 1981 Sean O'Grady battled Hilmer Kenty for the WBA World Lightweight title at Ballys Park Place Hotel Casino in Atlantic City the 15 round bout ended in a unannimous decision win for O'Grady.

programmes.t: Sergio Martinez vs Julio Cesar Chavez Jr
programmes.d: On September 15th, 2012, Sergio Martinez fought Julio Cesar Chavez Jr for the WBC Middleweight Title at the Thomas & Mack Center in Las Vegas. Despite an incredible effort from Chavez Jr in the final round, Martinez survived and won by decision.

On April 17th, 2010, Sergio Martinez fought Kelly Pavlik for the World Middleweight Championship at Boardwalk Hall in Atlantic City. Showing his confidence, Martinez put on the pressure and found his range, earning an unanimous decision victory.

Rob reluctantly agrees to take care of Buddy's dog for the weekend.

Six-year-old Ritchie asks his parents about the birds and the bees.

For Rob, a forgotten loan turns into a forgotten debt and a television script.
Rob finds himself besieged by the parents of neighborhood prodigies.
Ritchie's expanding vocabulary starts to branch out in unexpected directions.
While his wife is away, Buddy moves in with the Petries and quickly wears out his welcome.
Rob's paternal pride suffers a cruel shock when he finds out his 6-year-old son is ashamed of him.
Sally drags the entire production staff to a bowling alley, where she unveils a new dance and song.
Laura believes Rob, on jury duty, has been unfairly swayed by the beautiful blonde defendant.

Rob's shy brother (Jerry Van Dyke) has confidence while sleepwalking.
Rob's brother (Jerry Van Dyke) auditions for the show while awake.
Buddy laments the decline of the American male and yearns for the "good old days."

Rob tries to help an old radio comedy writer make a comeback.
One of Ritchie's pet ducks dies.
To prove that a wife cannot recognize her husband on the phone, Rob calls Laura for a date.
Rob recalls his and Laura's attempts to get married when Ritchie brings up the subject.
Rob is puzzled when he discovers Laura's secret bank account.
A hypnotist visits a Petrie dinner party where Rob accidentally picks up a post-hypnotic suggestion.
Rob has some explaining to do when son Ritchie learns that his middle name is Rosebud.
A balladeer brings romance into television comedy writer Sally Rogers' life.
A tiring day causes a spat between the Petries.
Rob suspects co-writers Buddy and Sally of carrying on a clandestine romance.
Ritchie claims he keeps being attacked by a giant woodpecker.
Rob fears he is allergic to his own family.

Rob must choose a Cleopatra for a community theater production.
After a string of burglaries in the neighborhood, the Petrie home is pillaged.

Rob unwittingly describes Laura as a "nut" on TV.

Rob fears a walnut will steal his imagination. Guest: Danny Thomas.
Laura tries to break Rob of his expensive habit of picking up the check.
Rob ignores Laura's warning to stay off the big slopes on his first skiing trip.
The Petries hire a painter who ends up painting much more than just their living room.
Rob, Laura and the office gang put together a variety show to help out an old friend.
Jacques Savon, who has played a curious part in both Rob's and Laura's pasts, suddenly reappears.
Rob finds himself very out of place at a dinner party for celebrated literati.
Guest host Tracy Rattigan is a charming but incorrigible flirt.
Rob finds himself caught in the middle after Buddy announces he is going to divorce Pickles.
Laura's old flame re-enters the Petries' lives as Alan Brady's newest sponsor.

Rob finds himself in hot water after inadvertently lifting a comedy idea from another show.

An underworld figure involves Rob, Sally and Buddy in an unusual writing assignment.
Rob and Jerry's friendship is sorely tested when they buy a boat together.
Rob feels very much the hero when he hires a maid for his overworked wife, Laura.
Rob struggles between his civic duty and his fear for his family's safety.
The entire "Alan Brady" staff presents a Christmas show instead of the script.
A young chorus girl on "The Alan Brady Show" falls desperately in love with Rob.
Rob finds himself in trouble when Laura interferes with an interview he is giving on Alan Brady.
When a handsome bachelor moves in next door, Rob and Laura become matchmakers.

Police Lt. Kinderman (George C. Scott) notices similarities between his current murder investigation and the methods used by the Gemini killer (Brad Dourif) who was executed 15 years before. He soon discovers a hospitalized mental patient (Jason Miller) claiming to be the dead serial killer, but who looks uncannily like a priest Kinderman knew who died during an exorcism. As more bodies are found, Kinderman looks for connections between the two supposedly dead men.
