Love is in the air as the first day of spring arrives in Hooterville. And who better to lead the town in celebrating it than Lisa. She is resolved to show Oliver just what spring is all about and sets out to produce a Spring festival celebration.

It's a hair-raising episode as Eb (Tom Lester) enrolls in a correspondence course to become a barber. Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Eddie Albert) give him the money to learn the trade but learning how to cut hair by mail has its glitches.

For a lawyer, Oliver should be more careful about what he signs. Lisa reminds him that two years ago Oliver made her a promise to take her back to New York for a two-week vacation. And she has it in writing� on the bottom of the kitchen drawer.

It's hard to know who has a curse over Oliver, but he sure has his hands full with Lisa and her fellow Hungarian Lazlo Broslav. Lazlo appears with a letter claiming he once saved the life of Lisa's uncle, and now her family must repay the debt.

There's a problem in Hooterville: no farmer seems able to grow a cash crop on account of the quality of the soil. But as it turns out from Oliver's (Eddie Albert) soil and mineral research, the oft misunderstood rutabaga is an ideal choice.

Green Acres goes Hollywood in this first installment of a two-part season finale. When Arnold the pig appears in a play at the Hooterville Theater, Lisa (Eva Gabor) arranges for an old friend to give Arnold a chance on the big screen.

It's a swine-sational third season finale for Green Acres, as Oliver and Lisa chaperone Arnold, the Ziffel's talented pig, to Hollywood for his big screen test. There's only one problem, Lisa failed to mention that Arnold is not your normal actor.

Hooterville is abuzz as the townsfolk enter a contest sponsored by Peterson's Poi Juice, with a trip to Hawaii as the top prize. But no one expects the winner to be Arnold, the Ziffels' talented pig. Maybe a pig might fly after all, to the islands!

A charity rummage sale asks for donated clothing. Being among the wealthier residents of Hooterville, the organizers look to the Douglases. It isn't long before Oliver has to stop Lisa from giving away his entire wardrobe!

Love is in the air when Eb is quickly engaged to Loreli Appleby, whom he has only known for a day. Eb tries to impress Loreli's father, a farmer, but in typical fashion, he accidentally ruins his future father-in-law's cabbage crop.

When Fire Chief Joe Carson is looking for a way to go to Miami, he hires Oliver as his assistant, hoping Oliver will pay for the trip. The plan backfires, no pun intended, when Oliver starts pointing out what a poor job the chief has been doing.

The highways in Hooterville are in dire need of repair. Oliver is fed up and believes he can make a difference by complaining to his state representative, Ben Hanks. But Hanks' popularity proves greater than his sense of responsibility.

Lisa feels like she should be contributing more and wants to start working in Oliver's construction business. Lisa is like a fish out of water as she arrives to the Monroes' workshop in overalls and causes one problem after another.

Lisa plays bovine matchmaker when Oliver and Lisa decide it is time for their female cow, Eleanor, to start providing milk for the farm. Oliver makes arrangements for Eleanor to mooooove in with the neighbor's bull, but Lisa has other ideas.

The townsfolk look forward to "Old Mail Day", when once a year undelivered mail is handed out. The delayed mail includes a letter all the way from 1917! Oliver is upset by the poor service, but his complaints land with more impact than he intended.

When word spreads that an agricultural student is coming to Hooterville to study with county agent Hank Kimball, no one seems to be interested. However, things change when the folks discover that the student is an attractive blonde.

This episode tells the unusual tale of Hooterville's founding. As the town prepares for its centennial, Oliver announces a reenactment of the town's origins and casts himself and Lisa in the roles of Horace and Doris Hooter.

When a blue feather arrives in the mail for Lisa, her Hungarian roots tell her that trouble is brewing. The feather is a symbol of malfortune to come, and she suspects it was sent by Hungarian gypsies, a warning that they are out to get her.

Don't count chickens before they hatch! Oliver thinks he's laid a gold egg of an idea when he decides to dive beak first into the business of raising chickens. Lisa, on the other hand, sees little difference between raising chickens and children.

All that glitters is not frosted cereal. After a jewelry heist in Chicago, the robbers foolishly stash their booty in the grain bin of a cereal manufacturer. Oliver and Lisa discover the jewels in their bowl of Crickly Wickly!

Oliver Wendell Douglas returns from farm to firm... law firm, that is. When a young and ambitious local graduates from law school, he looks for a potential partner in Hooterville. Oliver is the logical choice. Lisa and Eb help the new venture.

After partnering with a young, local lawyer, Oliver has opened a new law office in Hooterville. However, their secretary, Lisa, shows a lack of necessary skills. Soon, Lisa's job is on the line, even if she is married to one of the partners.

When the Young Peoples Agricultural Society holds their annual convention in Washington, D.C., local members Eb, Mr. Kimball, and Arnold the pig get ready to make the big trip. Oliver and Lisa serve as unintended chaperones.

While Lisa and Oliver consider what to do on their unplanned trip to Washington D.C., Mr. Haney rents their house to a family of eight. Meanwhile in the nation's capital, Lisa and Eb tour the White House, and Mr. Kimball makes official trouble.

When a charmingly sweet doe wanders onto the Douglas farm, an enchanted Lisa befriends the beautiful animal. Having had her heart won over, Lisa resolves to have all deer hunting banned in Hooterville, winning support however necessary.

Farmhand Eb plans to take his girlfriend to a fancy restaurant for her birthday. Only problem is he can't afford it. Oliver encourages Eb to get creative and figure out how to earn the money himself. And if Eb is anything, it's creative.

Lisa becomes enchanted with the diary of a Lydia Plunkett. Found in an old trunk in the barn, the diary from 1898 tells Lydia's life story as a successful businesswoman. Eb and Lisa are glued to every page of the story, but Oliver isn't impressed.

Mr. Haney and Fred Ziffel try to persuade Oliver to invest in a new business venture. "Looney Luke" Needlinger claim to have invented a machine that can turn hay into fresh milk. Oliver is skeptical and tries to prove the machine is a white lie.

Lisa's "Mudder" pays a surprise visit to Lisa and Oliver. Eb good-naturedly introduces her as the Queen of Sicily. As a result, the entire town treats her like royalty. They even go so far as to hold a special day in her honor.

Arnold Ziffel, Hooterville's beloved swine is thought to have rightful claim to a $20,000 fortune. The Birnbacher pork empire has promised that the descendant of the famous weather-predicting pig, Herman, will inherit the vast sum.

Oliver, Lisa and Eb travel to Chicago with Arnold to prove the pig is the rightful heir to the Birnbacher pork empire. Will this pig get rich? Arnold makes a surprising prediction that baffles all, including all the lawyers involved.

When Oliver returns home with Arnold, the citizens in town hold a large reception for Arnold. But when Oliver receives a phone call from a lawyer representing an eccentric relative of the Birnbachers, the riches go into question.

Oliver is mad over the town's dirt road, especially when he finds out that the state set aside money over thirty years ago to fix it. Oliver goes to the Capitol to get the road paved but hits a roadblock when the Ziffels' house must be torn down.

Lisa foretells of a mysterious stranger that will appear into Oliver's life. Enter Tadpole Talbot, Eb's childhood friend who has become a singing sensation. Tadpole has convinced Eb to go out on the road with him and join his band as a roadie.

Oliver become alarmed that the youth of his beloved town, Hooterville is dwindling so he calls an emergency town meeting to prevent them from leaving. The next thing Oliver knows is that his barn has been volunteered for the new youth center.

Oliver is asked to speak at the local high school about his illustrious law career and makes quite an impression on student Kathy Baxter. Oliver must contend with Kathy's fawning as well as her jealous boyfriend is not very happy with Oliver.

Hank Kimball proposes marriage to lady carpenter Ralph Monroe while under the influence of heavy medication. Lisa plans an amazing country wedding only to find out that, Sam, the Justice of the Peace, has forgotten to new his license.

Oliver plants his crops, worrying that they haven't been planted in time for a harvest. Lisa tries to be helpful and mixes up a batch of sour lemonade. Oliver pours out the bitter elixir in the newly planted field, with an unimaginable consequence.

Sam Drucker does not stock any cosmetics in his store, much to the chagrin of Lisa. Lisa decides to set up a "small" display in the store. When the merchandise is delivered, it forces Mr. Drucker to retreat to the front porch.

Mr. Haney discovers an old wish book dating back to 1898 that tells the story of Calvin and Tessie Whittaker who once owned the Douglases' farm and how Calvin traveled to Hollywood to pitch his idea of putting a mouse named Dickey into films.

Oliver and Lisa discover a root cellar under their house and become trapped when it collapses in on them. Their only hope to get rescued rides on a hilarious game of charades between Arnold the pig and Mr. Drucker.

Oliver goes to New York to finish up a case at his old firm. Meanwhile back on the farm, Lisa and Eb find a puppy left on the doorstep. Lisa, in all her innocence, leads Oliver to believe the puppy, affectionally named Freddie, is a human baby.

Oliver has been invited to give a speech at the Bar Association. He is there to advocate for the hiring of ex-convicts. He eventually ends up regretting his speech when he is forced to hire an ex-convict by the name of Willie Dunhill.

Oliver's crops are getting stomped on by Irene the cow. In his frustration, he fires a shotgun to scare Irene away. Instead the blast leads to a hilarious misunderstanding among Lisa, Eb and a life-sized fiberglass cow.

Oliver has become the new School Board President. Unfortunately, Oliver's first day on the job is anything but smooth. Arnold the pig is expelled from his duties as the school's mascot, and Fred Ziffel implores Oliver to defend Arnold.

After receiving a tax refund from the IRS, Oliver inspires his fellow citizens to make similar requests. There's only one problem... those making requests haven't paid their taxes! Nevertheless, the IRS mistakenly sends out half a million dollars!

Oliver is insistent that he and Lisa have a romantic Sunday afternoon picnic, all alone. His romantic gesture for two turns into a picnic for the entire town. Finally, Oliver finds them a romantic refuge in a most unlikely place.

Local boy Dinky Watson has one heck of a story to tell anyone who will listen. When Dinky convinces Lisa to buy a "moon rock" for the considerable sum of $14, Oliver suspects that she is the victim of a practical joke.

When Lisa's Uncle Fedor comes to visit her at the farm, he is visibly upset. He claims that someone is following him. Indeed, Fedor is convinced that the Secret Police are out to steal back a valuable scientific formula, which only he knows.

When Eb places an ad in a magazine claiming to be a wealthy landowner, it catches the eye of a young socialite. When the young woman makes an unexpected visit to Hooterville, Eb is forced to keep up his ruse.

Oliver is upset when he finds out Arnold the pig and he share the same birthday. Jealous that Arnold is getting more attention than he is, Oliver becomes convinced that Lisa is throwing him a surprise party and drives all over town in search for it.

Oliver and Lisa play host to four children from the city, who find themselves in Hooterville as part of a rural exposure program. The kids learn how to milk the cow, pick vegetables, plant seeds, and share sleeping quarters with four-legged friends.

Little Lori Baker, who after coming to stay with the Douglases on a rural experience program, is staying on at the Douglas farm. This city girl, like Oliver, has found that she loves the country life! Lisa decides to throw Lori a welcome party.

Lisa tells a rather fanciful version of how she met and fell in love with Oliver. The Douglases' house guest, little Lori Baker from the city, is all ears. The tale begins with how Lisa's father, the king, was exiled, causing Lisa to flee to Paris.

The residents of Hooterville assume that Oliver Douglas must be broke when Lisa is spotted looking for work and standing in line at the soup kitchen. But assumptions in this town, even logical ones, are bound to be wrong.

There is the old adage that warns never to discuss politics with your spouse... but what if you are both running for the same office?! That predicament comes true when Oliver and Lisa face each other in the Hooterville mayoral election.

Lisa and Oliver try to sort out of the troubles of fools in love. The problems begin when Eb invites both his girlfriend and another young woman to the same dance, while Arnold the pig falls for not one, but two attractive bovines.

Oliver is having a tough time. He has no one to help him pick the apples from his orchard, and he's promised to teach Lisa how to drive. The neighbors are all injured from assisting other harvests, and Lisa has a run-in with a sheriff.

Eb feels the time is right to settle down and marry Darlene. However, he has nowhere near the money it will take to make a down payment on a house. With the help of the Douglases, who have given him two acres of land, Eb applies for a loan.

Eb believes he has found his destiny when an accounting course he has enrolled in turns out to be acting workshop. All the world's a stage. Ed dives into acting and turns every simple interaction at the Douglas farm into a starring role.

After Lisa attends a Women's Liberation League meeting, she gives Oliver a scolding for denying her equal rights and demands to swap chores. While Lisa does a stellar job at Oliver's work, Oliver's attempts at hers leave something to be desired.

Oliver refuses to take Lisa to New York City to attend the wedding anniversary of an old friend. Meanwhile, Eb, always up to something, has a new invisible friend named Charlie. To get her way, Lisa introduces her own invisible friend... Natasha.

Lisa gives the financially-challenged Eb her engagement ring to present to Darlene, his longtime sweetheart, so that he can pop the question. The ring is reportedly valued at $2,000, however, when Darlene's father has it appraised, it's a shocker.

The Douglases are offered a free paint job on their house and barn so long as they allow the paint company free advertising on their barn wall. Meanwhile, Lisa tries to make spaghetti for Oliver's upcoming birthday. Will it prove im-pasta-ble?

Lisa hosts the son of WWII hero Drobny, and all of Hooterville gets excited in anticipation of a surge of tourists. Trouble is, this hero was a duck, as is his son. Oliver tried to warn everyone they were making too much fuss over feathers.

Young lovers Eb and Darlene are just weeks away from their wedding day, but they must choose the marriage venue. It's hard to decide between a church and a car wash. At least it is for Eb, who is still looking for a way to pay for it all.

While staying with the Douglases, Arnold the Pig witnesses a bank robbery when he goes with the Douglases on an errand in Pixley. When Lisa asks him to describe the two robbers, Arnold, reliving the moment, loses his voice from fear.

Lisa worries about Drobny the duck when the water fowl stops eating and sleeping and suffers headaches. Eb suggests the duck needs a duck girlfriend. Lisa agrees and goes about town trying to the right partner for Drobny.

Oliver refuses to take Lisa to the annual Carpenter's Ball because he thinks the attendees are too eccentric for his liking. But Lisa has her own motives to attend. She is trying to get a romance sparked between two local singles.

When Oliver decides to attend night school and enrolls in a farming class, Lisa does the same, taking psychology. Before long, many of the residents of Hooterville are lining up for appointments with the eminent Dr. Lisa.

Aloha! The Douglases vacation in Hawaii. But the daughter of the hotel manager needs to keep secret that she double booked the honeymoon suite. The "sweet" surprise? While Lisa and Oliver settle in, they are unaware that the other room is occupied.

Oliver's heirloom watch is broken so he tries to find his ex-secretary Carol's address to ask her the name of the jeweler who fixed it last time. Carol is now working and living in Los Angeles, and we get a glimpse into her new life.

In this classic series' premiere episode, New York City attorney Oliver Wendell Douglas (Eddie Albert) satisfies his desire for the simple life by buying a farm, much to the chagrin of his wife, Lisa (Eva Gabor). John Charles Daly narrates the tale!

Oliver (Eddie Albert) brings his wife, Lisa (Eva Gabor), to their new home, a ramshackle farm near Hooterville, just outside of Pixley, where she gets to meet the town's oddball residents. Bea Benaderet, Edgar Buchanan and Frank Cady guest star!

Oliver (Eddie Albert) is ready to get farming, but Lisa (Eva Gabor) puts her foot down and says she will leave unless they can hire a decorator to fix the house! Meanwhile, Kate Bradley (Bea Benaderet) teaches Lisa how to make "hotscakes."

Is the Honeymoon period over already? The rumor mill has it that Lisa (Eva Gabor) has packed up and left Oliver (Eddie Albert). Actually, she went back to New York to close up their penthouse apartment. And Mr. Haney is up to his old tricks!

Oliver (Eddie Albert) calls in a roofer, a plumber and agricultural expert Hank Kimball (Alvy Moore). All of them give the same appraisal of his farm: it's a disaster! Meanwhile, Mr. Haney (Pat Buttram) has a few chickens he'd like to rent out!

The Douglases are awaiting the arrival of their furniture and they don't know it, but Oliver's mother is on her way, too. But when the furniture is accidentally delivered to Mr. Haney's new place, he tries to sell their own possession back to them.

Planting season ends in three weeks and Oliver has yet to get his land plowed. Meanwhile, Uncle Joe (Edgar Buchanan) needs a new shotgun before duck hunting season starts and schemes to solve both of their problems...without Oliver knowing it.

After a gang kills Apaches to steal their horses, Winnetou and his sister join forces with trapper Old Firehand. In the border town of Miramonte, they help defend the townspeople against the gang’s planned attack. As danger grows, Old Firehand also faces unexpected revelations about his former love and a long-hidden family secret.

The commander of a Texan fort in the Civil War refuses to surrender to the Northerners, and tries to buy the local Indian tribe chief's daughter. The sage man refuses, and the Southerners massacre the tribe and abduct the young squaw anyway. The noble squaw manages to escape, and hides out with a rough rancher, who dislikes Indians, but hates the Southerners more. The odd couple joins forces, and tactics, to exert ultimate vengeance on the men at the fort.
Two brothers who hate each other are going to spend Christmas with their mother. She tries to get them together.

Captain O’Hara saves Mary from Navajo warriors and brings her safely to Fort San Antonio. But her fiancé, Major Brooks, is not only O’Hara’s rival but also a ruthless enemy of the Native tribes. As tensions rise, O’Hara must fight for peace while facing personal betrayal and growing conflict.
Jeff sets out to murder each one of the five outlaws who robbed, raped and killed his poor sister.

Jack, a farmhand, accidentally impersonates the notorious outlaw "Bloody" Ben Harris. Now, on a treasure hunt, he must rely on a group of wild misfits to outsmart the outlaw he's pretending to be. With Harris hot on his trail, Jack must find the treasure and return to his true love, Olivia, before it’s too late.
Jeff Cameron is Tom Carter and he’s a man on a mission to get revenge for his brother Jerry, who was gunned down after pulling his life savings out of the Rio Canyon town bank.

Glenn Saxon, aka El Desperado, seeks justice for Mexicans and vengeance for his family. Orphaned by bandits, he targets the five men responsible, including outlaw Blackie Stark and Judge Wilkins. Amid schemes to control a wealthy daughter’s marriage, El Desperado maneuvers to make the guilty pay.

programmes.t: Patience Has a Limit, We Don't
programmes.d: During the Civil War, Corporal MacDonald hides a large gold shipment meant for the Union. Before he can retrieve it, he's killed—taking the secret location with him. Now, a Union lieutenant and MacDonald's two sons compete to uncover the buried treasure in a tense hunt filled with danger and deception.
Two gunmen ride into a town with a plan to collect a large unearned bounty but are caught up in the local war for land caused by the impending arrival of the railroad.

Reverend Miller arrives in Tucson where he wants to build a church, but on the very day of his arrival a gang raids the bank and the people of Tucson, suspicious of the new reverend because he is carrying a gun, immediately blame him for the robbery.

Johnny Ringo, a Texas Ranger, tracks down a counterfeiting ring, but the real challenge is a love triangle involving rancher Ray Scott, his sister Christine, saloon singer Annie, and gang boss Jackson. As Ringo tries to stop the counterfeiters, he learns the sheriff, his own partner, is behind it all, complicating the mission.
A double-cross in an arms deal prompts Mexican revolutionary Pancho Villa to raid a US Army weapons depot in Columbus, New Mexico.

programmes.t: Watch Out Gringo! Sabata Will Return
programmes.d: After a daring gold robbery, bandit Carrancho double-crosses his gang and hides the loot in a grave. As ruthless outlaws and gunmen close in, the chase for the stolen treasure turns into a deadly showdown.

programmes.t: Shoot the Living and Pray for the Dead
programmes.d: After Dan Hogan and his gang rob a bank, they hire a mysterious man to guide them across the Mexican border in return for half of the loot.

Sartana has a bounty on his head and he's wanted dead or alive. To eliminate this he makes a deal with the local politicians. If he hunts down the marauding Randal Brothers, the bounty will be removed.

After waking up with amnesia in the desert next to a dead man, Luke Barrett begins piecing together his past. A stranger in black reveals that Luke was hired to kill his own brother, Victor Barrett, a wealthy landowner. As Luke seeks the truth, a deadly confrontation looms, and his memory recovery brings both clarity and danger.

In the late 1800's, an army captain tries to tame the open plains of Argentina which are dominated by Indians and bandits. To help do this, the captain brings in a party of women to keep his soldiers happy.
The sons of a Colorado cattle baron, one biological and the other adopted, resent one another and fight for control of their father's cattle empire.

A soldier deserts his unit before a major battle after receiving an urgent message. He flees to Mexico to marry his pregnant girlfriend, defying her father's wishes. However, unexpected events turn him into an outlaw, bent on revenge against everyone who stood in his way. Now, his quest for vengeance puts him on a dangerous path.
An evil arthritic rancher and his murderous daughter are having settlers killed to prevent them from selling their land to the railroad.

A relentless bounty hunter pursues a brutal gang of gunrunners deep into Mexico. As he crosses the lawless borderlands, he’s drawn into a deadly chase where justice and vengeance blur in the desert heat.
A self-proclaimed Russian prince, a Mexican bandit and a radical Irish female journalist team up during the Mexican Revolution to find fortune and notoriety.

Young adventurer Gipo owns a fifth of a rock marking a gold mine. With the help of the alluring Lulu Belle, he braves deadly dangers to recover the missing pieces and claim the treasure, facing treachery and peril along the way.

Brat appeals to JD about Bow's scandalous new album, but his response throws her for a loop. Shaniah and JD join forces to make positive changes in their community. BT's birthday party culminates in an all-out girl fight.

Jesseca persuades Brat to give Jhonni another chance, but tempers flare when Brat and Jhonni face off. Bow learns that one wild night could affect the rest of his life. Tammy's shocked when Ayana and Ree's longstanding feud spirals out of control.

Pimpin' and Diamond call it quits, and Khi can't resist making a move when he learns Diamond is single. Meanwhile, Bow anxiously awaits the results of his paternity test and considers how a baby son could impact his future.

Bow finds out if he's a new daddy. An emergency at Deb and Brat's EP party causes Jhonni to suffer a cataclysmic meltdown, and Waka is caught in the crossfire. Meanwhile, Diamond embraces newly single life, and Khi prepares to make his move.

Angela opens up about her devastating breakup and the pressures of living in the spotlight. Vanessa throws a party to reunite the heirs and clear the air while Romeo gets caught up in a love triangle. Boogie's addiction takes a turn for the worst.

Tee Tee and Briana beef over Romeo's affections. Dame enlists Master P to scare Boogie straight. Angela moves to LA for a fresh start. Romeo hopes to get close to his newly-single former flame. Red flags are raised about naive Egypt's relationship.

Game night at Pepa's house spirals into fight night! Dame and Pep clash over the severity of Boogie's addiction while Briana enters to confront a nasty rumor. Angela and Romeo reunite for the first time since Angela's breakup.

Angela and Romeo's Orlando getaway leads to a hotel nightcap. Briana and Pepa clash at a releasing ceremony when Pepa brings alcoholic spirits. Boogie is blindsided when he is lead to a surprise drug intervention.

Boogie's intervention spirals out of control when Kristinia and Briana nearly come to blows! Romeo and Angela discuss their relationship. Angela drops a bomb on her and Vanessa's business plan. On the brink of destruction, Boogie checks into rehab.

Pepa's son Tyran comes to town with old baggage in tow. Tyran interrogates Egypt's boyfriend Sam. Drama ensues at a welcome party for Tyran. Master P is blindsided when he discovers that his incarcerated brother has gone on a hunger strike!

The danger surrounding Master P's incarcerated brother comes to a head. Tee Tee plays cupid for Briana to make amends, but her grand plan backfires! Tyran struggles to get Pepa's attention. After a blowup, Angela and Vanessa must unite for charity.

Boogie is released from rehab and temptation strikes! Master P mentors the guys on a camping trip. Family therapy with Pepa and her son, Tyran, bursts into flames. Kristinia meets her cousin Kyndall, El DeBarge's daughter, for the first time ever.

Angela and her siblings talk about marriage while Tee Tee goes on a first date with Romeo. Tee Tee's hair event sparks trouble when Kristinia's cousin, Kyndall, and her enemy, Briana, face off. Since their fight night blowup, Pepa and Dame reunite!

Marriage is on the radar! JoJo is pressed to make a proposal. Meanwhile, Romeo's torn between Angela and Tee Tee. Egypt's bikini shoot turns left when her boyfriend, Sam tries to take over. Drama ignites when momager, Pepa, checks Egypt!

Kristinia moves to Sin City and throws a welcome party! The rivalry between Briana and Kristinia comes to a head. Tee Tee is blindsided when Romeo reveals that he has a secret crush on another woman! Panic strikes when Egypt and Sam run off to elope!

Angela is shell-shocked when she suffers a major loss. Romeo runs to Angela's side. Boogie betrays his family to avoid his father, Dame. A family dispute between the Pepas comes to a head at Romeo's yacht party. A table is flipped and fists fly!

Angela is blindsided when Vanessa takes business matters into her own hands. Pepa's security guard turned boyfriend violates his new father figure role. A disgruntled Briana comes for Tee Tee. In a long-awaited reunion, Dame unleashes on Boogie!

Boogie and Dame have a life-altering meet up. Sparks fly between Romeo and Angela. Angela avoids Vanessa at the racetrack and pushes Vanessa to her breaking point. A shocking scandal rocks Pepa's world when Aundre's past comes back to haunt him.

Lil Twist brings trouble to Dame's Culture Vulture Event which threatens Sam. Meanwhile, Twist has eyes for Egypt. Romeo stands up to Master P and suffers the blowback. A scandal from Aundre's past emerges and jeopardizes Pepa's million-dollar deal.

Romeo and Bow Wow face off in an epic battle of the Lil's! Pepa's conflicted between her career and her relationship. On a romantic stroll in New Orleans, Angela and Romeo take shocking next steps to move forward in their relationship.

Angela and Romeo's double date backfires! Pepa's relationship with Aundre takes a turn for the worst. Tee Tee throws a singles party where an uninvited guest pops up with a vengeance. Sam and Lil Twist nearly come to blows over Egypt.

Romeo finds himself in troubled waters with Angela when he drops out of their double date. Dame confronts his nemesis. Pepa struggles with a broken heart. Master P warns Eric about digging up Eazy-E's death. Vanessa's birthday surprise.

Angela opens up about her past at a Fearless Conference. Dame and Rocky struggle to conceive. Vanessa exposes a shocking secret. Suspicions around Eazy-E's death deepen. Briana blows up and storms off when feelings about her father are triggered.

Angela is set up on a hot date with someone other than Romeo. Meanwhile, JoJo prepares a surprise of a lifetime. Drama ignites at Lil Twist's listening party when Briana spirals down a dangerous path and everyone is shook.

Vanessa confronts Romeo about his feelings for Angela. Briana's birthday goes up in flames when Briana and Eric nearly come to blows. JoJo surprises his sisters when he takes them shopping for an engagement ring.

After a blind date disaster, Angela is blindsided when Romeo surprises her in New York. JoJo panics to pull off a marriage proposal. In the aftermath of an explosive birthday brawl, Briana's invite to Boogie's important showcase has everyone on edge.
Just when Angela and Romeo take a chance at love, Angela's world falls apart when tragedy strikes and shocks all. Dame checks on a troubled Briana who makes a brutal decision no one saw coming.
Romeo drops a bombshell on the Simmons family that rocks Angela to her core! Meanwhile, Egypt's boyfriend Sam does sneaky business at a pawn shop. Panic strikes when a secret engagement is exposed.

Angela and Romeo's rivalry comes to a head and sends shockwaves through Romeo's party. Vanessa's stuck in the middle and JoJo flies off the handle! Meanwhile, a scandal strikes Salt-N-Pepa. Angela is blindsided when Briana does the unexpected.

Romeo blocks everyone on social media and causes uproar, but Angela has receipts! Tee Tee and Tyran join forces to derail Sam and Egypt's trip to the altar, and warn Pepa and Treach before it's too late. Angela plans to squash the beef with Briana.

JoJo seeks marriage guidance from Rev Run when JoJo's baby fever strikes a bad chord with Tanice. Pepa warns Tee Tee to stop meddling in Egypt and Sam's relationship while Briana rages on. Ava breaks down over the legal war with her father Dame.

Angela and Briana's long-lasting feud comes to a head. A secret marriage shocks all. While Romeo is out of the country, Boogie shoots his shot with Angela. Rumor spreads that Tee Tee is in love with Sam and Lil Twist puts it on full blast!

With Romeo on ice, things fire up between Angela and Boogie. Tee Tee runs into some old foes. Sam is served a fair warning before he seeks Pepa and Treach's blessing to marry Egypt. Boogie opens up a rehab facility but Dame smells a scam.

Sam is shook when he asks Treach for his blessing to marry Egypt. Panic strikes when Tee Tee's sabotage derails Sam's proposal. Rev Run counsels JoJo and Tanice while they navigate through their relationship issues before officiating their marriage

Sam's proposal goes off without a hitch and triggers further investigation. Angela bursts into tears when she faces tragedy and heartbreak. Vanessa meets with Master P and is caught back in the middle of a major rivalry between Angela and Romeo.

All hell breaks loose at Egypt's 21st birthday when drama with Sam ignites and Tee Tee tries to shut the cameras down. Security is called when Briana and Eric's wife Aaliyah nearly come to blows. Bow Wow shows up for Angela just when tragedy strikes.

Angela's on the quest for love but the drama with Romeo ignites. Bow Wow arrives in LA to throw JoJo an epic bachelor party. Dame and Boogie clash and the mics come off. Pep's family war rages on when Sam and Tee Tee battle it out.

Bow Wow throws a wild night out for JoJo's bachelor party and things spiral out of control. Angela pops up and Bow sweats it out in the hot seat. Pepa and Dame go head-to-head over unsettled business. Egypt's fiancé Sam plans to reveal a big secret.

All hell breaks loose when Boogie and Ava confront Dame in a brutal family mediation. JoJo's wedding derails when his late nights at the studio push Tanice to her breaking point. Briana meets with an inside source and uncovers dirt on Sam.

Rev Run is blindsided when JoJo gets cold feet just before his wedding. Egypt's engagement party takes a dramatic turn when Romeo and Angela arrive and their feud rages on. Sam takes the stage and exposes a secret that nobody saw coming.

A melee breaks out when Pepa and Treach join forces to protect Egypt. JoJo and his fiancé Tanice battle to the altar, and things take a dramatic turn just before the ceremony. Bow Wow wants to reconnect with Angela and makes his move.

Angela and Romeo's rivalry explodes across headlines. Angela's ex Bow shows up. Tee Tee's rumored love for Sam enrages Pep's sister Maureen to lay down the law and Egypt's caught in the crossfire. The pressure of jail time tests the Dash family.

Egypt's ambushed by her family in Jamaica and the battle lines are drawn! Pep waves her gavel from the sidelines and Tee Tee drops an unexpected bomb. Angela and Bow's new partnership ignites. Boogie struggles to make peace with Dame.
Lil Twist's birthday party explodes into chaos when Briana and Egypt come to blows. Things ignite for Angela and Bow Wow when their romantic past threatens their new business relationship.

Fists fly between Egypt and Briana and the battle lines are drawn! Twist and Sam go head-to-head. Romeo goes ballistic over the drama and enlists Eric to summon everyone to a sit down. Romeo's request enrages the Simmons family.

Romeo's sit-down sparks an uproar throughout the entire cast. Eric's caught in the crossfire and Angela puts Romeo on full blast. After Egypt battles Briana with her fists, she's forced to suffer the wrath of her mother Pepa.

Romeo's sit-down bursts into flames when he enters with Master P and his entourage. The Simmons family strikes back while Boogie stands up for battle. Later, Bow shows up and Romeo is pushed to the brink. Egypt enters the lion's den of Treach's fury.

Romeo quits the show and the cast responds. Treach finds out about Egypt's fist fight with Briana and there is hell to pay. Vanessa's battle with her weight reaches a breaking point when Angela pushes her to model for a swimwear photo shoot.

Tamara, guía de una galería de arte privada, es acusada de robar las joyas del renombrado coleccionista Dubrovsky. Indignado, él la busca para encararla, pero descubre que ella también es víctima de la estafa, no la villana que imaginaba. Entre ambos nace un romance. Pero el amor no será sencillo: Tamara lleva años enamorada en secreto del dueño de la galería, de cuyo favor depende su suerte, y Dubrovsky está casado con una esposa que no piensa quedarse de brazos cruzados.

¿Cuál es la mejor opción? ¿Un refugio familiar tranquilo o un romance apasionado? ¿Una esposa, con la que ha vivido durante décadas, o una joven amante? Después de pensarlo mucho, el protagonista de la película, Alexei, de 40 años, opta por rehacer su vida...
Alexei confiesa su infidelidad y deja a Vera. Se casa con Marina, pero pronto conoce a otra mujer, Varvara, con quien siente una conexión profunda.
Alexei busca a Varvara y se enamora de ella. Marina descubre su romance y le envía fotos comprometedoras, desatando una crisis.
Marina exige el divorcio. Alexei encuentra en casa de Varvara objetos de su antiguo hogar con Vera y descubre una impactante verdad.

Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy

Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!
When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.
Frankie and Sophie challenge newcomers Zac and Charlie to an epic sled race.
A teenage boy journeys to find his missing father only to discover that he's actually Bigfoot.

The lovable Ozzy’s pampered life is thrown into turmoil after his family drops him at Blue Creek before their vacation. Ozzy quickly learns that Blue Creek is a dog prison and he’ll need to rely on some new friends to help him break out and get back home.
A loyal dog and a vigilante cat embark on a space age voyage to find their way home.

A rookie race-car driver gets the opportunity to compete against the reigning champion. With help from a former driver, he must overcome treacherous terrain, rival racers and unexpected obstacles to prove he has what it takes.

A cat named Blanket lives in the city with his son, Cape. One day, Cape decides to leave home and embarks on an adventure to find the legendary cat's paradise. To find his son, Blanket must overcome his fear and reconcile with his past.
When his beloved Queen bee Marguerite is kidnapped, vagabond cricket Apollo who has been framed for the crime, teams up with the other bugs to save the Queen and the entire kingdom.
A boy at risk of being sent to boarding school by his Dad - and three aliens stranded due to watching too much TV - must help each other out.

After purchasing a mysterious shrink ray machine, Vick accidentally shrinks Briar, Bramble, and himself. The tiny team must put aside their differences and embark on one big journey to restore their size and their friendship.

In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. programmes.d: On the show, philanthropist Omar Sharif, Jr. suggests new strategies for progress, fencing coach Lewis Weiss encourages queer athletes to be proud, reckons that all great art includes LGBTQ+ voices behind the curtain.

programmes.t: How Can Queers Take Back Fashion? | The Q Agenda
programmes.d: Is fashion getting gayer, even among straight people? Vintage stylist Johnny Valencia joins our hosts today to pin the beat on queer fashion, along with fashion designer Eduardo Lucero and WNBA stylist Courtney Mays.

programmes.t: Has the Algorithm Changed? | The Q Agenda
programmes.d: Social media guru Angel Merino shares how influencers may need to diversify their output across channels. Content creator Robby Arroyo discusses how he makes intentional content. Singer Baby Yors talks about his journey moving to the United States.

programmes.t: Chicago: Volare Restaurant | Foodie On The Go
programmes.d: Chiquis visits Volare, a renowned family-owned Italian restaurant in Chicago, led by Chef Massimo, a Bologna, Italy native. Together, they prepare two of the restaurant’s most popular dishes: squid ink risotto with seafood and tiramisu.

programmes.t: Solvang: Peasants Feast | Foodie On The Go
programmes.d: Chiquis explores Solvang, a town with deep Danish heritage in Santa Barbara County on California’s central coast, where she meets Chef Michael Cherney at the beloved Peasants Feast to try their infamous dish: the Copenhagen Caesar Salad.

programmes.t: Los Angeles: Yang Chow Restaurant | Foodie On The Go
programmes.d: Chiquis goes to a popular Chinese spot in her hometown to find out what all the hype is about. While Benny, the manager, tells her the interesting story of Yang Chow Restaurant, she enjoys some of the best flavors she’s ever had.
Jenicka kicks off her season of self-growth by inviting her sister Chiquis to a special getaway in Santa Barbara: a cozy sleepover beneath the stars, surrounded by nature.

programmes.t: The Road Trip Continues | Jenicka's Journeys
programmes.d: Jenicka’s adventure continues with sister Chiquis. The special getaway in Santa Barbara brings more than one surprise and some difficult conversations.

Jenicka decides to let go of control, and her friend Snow Tha Product takes full advantage of it, surprising her in a big way by pushing her to face some of her deepest fears. A powerful lesson awaits on the other side.

A hastily married couple quickly devolve into a life of affairs, meddling parents, and therapy.
It's been a decade since Ben (Duplass) and Andrew (Leonard) were the bad boys of their college campus. Ben has settled down and found a job, wife, and home.
Frank (Joel Murray) has had enough of the downward spiral of American culture. Divorced, recently fired, and possibly terminally ill, Frank feels he has nothing left to live for.
Veteran actor Andy Garcia steps into the director's chair for his first voyage into feature filmmaking with this heartfelt tribute to revolutionary, late-'50s-era Cuba featuring Dustin Hoffman.
A musician couple captures a sound not meant for human ears. Soon, a stranger knocks on their door and their reality begins to blur.
The very day he’s about to drive his family to a new life in the city, geologist Kristian Elkjord senses something wrong with the mountain that overlooks his scenic town.

Ana joins an army of girls engaged in a never-ending war. Ana trains as a sharpshooter and discovers newfound freedom and courage. Though she finds strength, she comes to realize that she’s not the killer they want her to be.
Four young siblings vow to stay together when their mother dies. But when a ghostly presence torments them and a lawyer threatens their pact, the four must stand together or be torn apart forever.
Determined to honor his father's scouting legacy an Assistant Scoutmaster convinces a group of kids to secretly ditch a slumber party in favor of a weekend scout trip.
Recently divorced, newly rich, and utterly miserable, Danny [Kevin Corrigan] would seem to be the perfect test subject for a definitive look at the relationship between money and happiness.
A newlywed couple's idyllic country-lake honeymoon descends into chaos.

Alice (Emily Beecham) has engineered a special flower that makes its owner happy. Against company policy, Alice takes one home to her son. As their plant grows, so does Alice's suspicion that her new creation may not be as harmless as they thought.
Stream critically acclaimed independent films, powerful documentaries, and world cinema with Magnolia Selects.
Kat Connors' (Shailene Woodley) glamorous but strange mother Eve vanishes. Kat is excited by her new freedom but disturbing facts surface and the mystery begins to haunt her.
Golden Globe® Winner for best foreign language film. Katja’s family is killed in a terrorist attack and her life falls apart. The killers are set free and Katja can do nothing else but seek justice.

When a young mother and true believer from a violent IRA family is captured by British spies, she is forced to betray everything she believes in for the sake of her son in this taut, high-stakes thriller.
The story of New Zealander Burt Munro, who spent years building a 1920 Indian motorcycle -- a bike which helped him set the land-speed world record at Utah's Bonneville Salt Flats in 1967.
It's Christmas Eve in Tinseltown and Sin-Dee (newcomer Kitana Kiki Rodriguez) is back on the block.
A love story and murder mystery inspired by the true story of the infamous missing persons case in New York.
Camille's life as a lonely suburban teenager changes when she befriends a group of girl skateboarders.
Patrick Wilson and Jessica Biel star in this Hitchcockian noir based on a novel by Patricia Highsmith (The Talented Mr. Ripley, Carol).
After a painful breakup, Ben develops insomnia. To kill time, he starts working the late night shift at the local supermarket, where his artistic imagination runs wild.

Change is in the air on the outback cattle property of Drovers Run.
The Drovers girls have a tough time adjusting to Nick as the new "Man of the House,"
Tess is thrown when Nick asks her to update her will.
Jaz is haunted by the death of her fiancé Mark
Sally Clements, Nick's ex-girlfriend, arrives at Drovers Run with news that is hard to conceal. .
Tensions are rife with Kane now living in the cottage with Stevie
Sally and her baby move into Wilgul with the help of Nick and Tess.
All the women of Drovers Run plan take on the big boys of the sheep industry at the annual Wool Board Expo.
Meg heads home early from the city in hopes she can be of some comfort to Tess during her time out with Nick.
The stubborn side of Dave is exposed when he finds an injured horse and believes he has found a descendent.
Harry is secretly thrilled when he hears Sandra is back in town, however, their meeting doesn't go well.
Incapacitated by an injured foot, a bored Stevie has become addicted to the two-way radio.
The women of Drovers Run are no longer a team of four.
Kate organises a reunion of the high school hiking club.
Harry reconsiders his plans for Killarney and he makes it clear that he favours Nick over Alex.
Nick discovers that Harry's heart condition could be quite serious and he goes into denial.
Will Hamilton, an old boyfriend from Stevie's school days in Broken Hill shows up at Drovers Run.
In trouble again, Luke promises a concerned Jodi that he will extricate himself from the criminal's grasp.
Tess's other cousin, Regan, visits Drovers Run and causes a few problems.
Dave and Regan's flirtation steps up a level when Dave offers to help cure her of her animal phobia.
Tess makes the difficult decision that they will go overseas for six months.
Things are in a state of flux, if not panic, with the imminent departure of Tess and Nick.
When Regan starts the process to mine Drovers Run, the other women put up a fight and vow to stop her.
Today is Harry's birthday and he's in a foul mood. Alex is stuck giving Sandra a lift to Gungellan.
Kate's grandmother comes for a visit.
Harry buys the truck stop and appoints Moira as manager, leaving Terry as a lowly mechanic.
Stevie borrows a water pump but leaves without the right hose.
Stevie locks horns with Sandra during a drought but later helps her through a personal crisis.
Stevie thrilled at the prospect of a visit from Rose but things sour when Stevie's sister Michelle arrives with her.
Caught off guard when Rose discovers a baby's hospital bracelet.
Patrick, Dave's adventurer brother literally parachutes onto Drovers Run and ensnares Kate's heart.
Jodi is on top of the world when she receives a birthday gift from the deceased Jack McLeod.
Dave is forced to question his behaviour when his former student threatens him with a sexual harassment suit.
Meg agonises over Jodi's rejection of her.
When Tess returns home to Drovers Run, she discovers the exciting news that she's pregnant.
Tess has been holed up in her room since the news of Nick's death.
Harry quickly sets about organising his grandson's future.
Stevie can no longer deny the love she has developed for Alex, but she struggles to tell him.
A week has passed Alex's mysterious disappearance, but then he returns with his new fiancée.
Alex and Fiona's engagement is publicly announced thanks to a meddling Harry.
Stevie is trying to deal with the fact that Alex may never be hers. She brings home a young guy for the night.
After the crop-dusting incident, Drovers has lost its contracts and the women struggle.
Jodi is stunned when Tess offers her half her share of the Run. Tess feels that Jodi should keep her heritage.
Kate falls and when Dave gives her a cursory examination, he notices a small sunspot on her back.
Kate falls and when Dave gives her a cursory examination, he notices a small sunspot on her back.
Nick returns home to Drovers Run but is troubled by shadowy flashbacks of Argentina and his mugging.
Nick is anxious to start up the cattle breeding program he never had the chance to realise in Argentina.
A man has a large knot on his head resulting from a car crash.
Dr. Sandra Lee assists Diane who has thousands of tumors all over her body.
Dennis has several giant growths on the back of his head.
A patient returns to see Dr. Lee and a specialist about his finger bump.
Dr. Sandra Lee helps Anthony who has a potentially dangerous facial cyst.
A man suffers from a growth on his back that affects his ability to work.
Che'Re has a prominent bump on her face that has put her in a dark place.
The growth between Shane's eyes could put him in danger at his job.
Ed wants his stomach lump removed before his girlfriend gets out of prison.
Corey has been labeled a devil worshipper because of his forehead growth.
The spirits of Christmas past, present and future surprise Dr. Lee.
A man suffers from a lump on his shoulder that prevents him from dancing.
A man has a bump hanging off of his arm that looks like it's breaking skin.
A woman feels insecure due to clusters of bumps all over her face.
Dr. Sandra Lee helps Matt who has tumors growing all over his body.
Dr. Sandra Lee helps Melissa who tries to hide a huge lipoma.
With bonus footage, Genner arrives from the Philippines with a bumpy nose.
Dr. Sandra Lee assists Louis who is covered in scaly, dry skin.
Stacey's shoulder growth prevents her from being the teacher she once was.
Dr. Sandra Lee helps Taylor with a dangerous bump at the base of her spine.
With bonus footage, Antonio has a mound on his spine.
A former cruise ship worker hopes Dr. Lee can remove her large back growth.
A man has large growths on his nose that impair his breathing.
Dr. Sandra Lee helps Amber who has hundreds of tumors on her face.
Virginia's large upper arm growths make it difficult to travel in her RV.
Shakisaha split her left earlobe after stretching it with gauges.
A patient returns to find out if a growth under his eye is skin cancer.
Monica hopes that Dr. Lee can remove some more of her face growths.
Stephen's large, bulbous nose gets him unwanted attention.
A full-face transplant patient battles a second life-threatening challenge.
A woman hopes a tooth transplant in her eye will stop her from going blind.
Parents of a 44-pound baby try to learn why their son can't stop eating.
An eleven-year-old boy is 6-feet-9-inches tall and still growing.
A woman's face is slowly being destroyed by a tumor.
A man has thousands of bubble-like growths covering every inch of his body.
A man with cold-like symptoms loses his limbs and lips.
A young boy lives with an agonizing skin condition.
Doctors try to diagnose a mystery condition that has deformed a man's head.
A mathematician born with severely deformed legs walks on all fours.
A man's maimed hand is sewn into his stomach to avoid amputation.
A baby born with eight limbs undergoes groundbreaking surgery.
Irish twins' muscles and flesh turn to bone.
A man with branch-like growths covering his hands and feet seeks treatment.
A boy with undeveloped legs walks on all fours.
A man with a leg that weighs more than 200 pounds seeks a diagnosis.
A man born with four legs finds out whether two can be surgically removed.
A boy has legs that have become so large he is unable to move.
A woman who cries blood is desperate for a diagnosis.
A man is born with his heart outside his rib cage.

Pure, unadulterated speed and fury! Experience blistering shred solos, aggressive riffing, and neck-snapping rhythms. Turn up the volume and brace yourself for an unstoppable wave of high-octane thrash metal chaos!

Step into the headquarters for everything that shakes the earth. From the pillars of the classics to the pioneers of the new era, this is where the heart of metal beats loudest. This is where you belong.

Found your new baseline. Rock Bottom digs deep into the rawest hard rock and alt-anthems. We’re hitting the floor with heavy riffs and soulful grit—no shovels required, just volume. This is the foundation of everything that kicks.

A tribute to the global brotherhood that refuses to fit in. This collection celebrates the unity that turns fans into a tribe. In this pit, no one stands alone—together, we are the loudest force on earth.

Brace for pure sonic devastation! Featuring relentless blast beats, guttural vocals, and razor-sharp riffs, this collection captures the raw intensity and uncompromising brutality of death metal at its absolute peak. Prepare for impact!

Where rock 'n' roll swagger meets the weight of metal. This collection bridges the gap, featuring everything from anthemic hard rock to core-shaking classics. It’s loud, it’s proud, and it’s built to move you.

Dive into pure power and unrelenting energy. Endless Heavyness is a non-stop wall of sound designed to hit hard and stay loud. No pauses, no compromises—just the most massive tracks to keep the momentum going. It’s not just loud; it’s eternal.

Ein legendärer Auftritt einer Hardrock-Legende in Hamburg! Diese Aufnahme vereint frisches Material mit zeitlosen Klassikern. Eine musikalische Reise durch mehr als dreißig Jahre Rockgeschichte, die pure Energie und Nostalgie verspricht.
A hotel manager risks his life and his family to take in over 1,000 refugees during the 1994 Rwandan genocide.
A judge (Spencer Tracy) presides over the trial of four German jurists accused of "legalizing" Nazi atrocities
Burt Lancaster stars as Robert Stroud, who spent 43 years in solitary confinement at Alcatraz.
A traveling salesman discovers he can hustle money in a Evangelical tent-show as easily as in a saloon.
An Army Major discovers a devious plot by a cabal of enemy leaders bent on political upheaval
A con man and a naïve hustler from Texas try to survive on the unforgiving streets of New York.
Boxer Jake La Motta's life is filled with violence both in out of the ring in this masterpiece.
Philip Marlowe faces the most bizarre case of his life, when a friend's suicide turns into a double murder.
In this 90s classic, a suicidal, career alcoholic falls for a compassionate Las Vegas hooker.
A tough and conservative security guard seeks out his drag queen neighbor for help to recover from a stroke

programmes.t: The Adventures Of Priscilla, Queen Of The Desert
programmes.d: A wonderfully inventive Australian comedy about three drag performers braving the vast, rugged outback.
Baseball season gets off to a rocky start when a veteran catcher and cocky young pitcher compete over a woman.
The true story of the infamous 1919 Chicago White Sox scandal, when the team throws the World Series.
The unlikely duo of a retired hockey player and an elitist figure skater go for Olympic gold together.
Sorority girl Carolyn (Christina Ricci) has the perfect life until she meets the "not-so-perfect" Pumpkin.
When Molly is hired as a 9-year-old's new caretaker, it's a perfect setup for both girls to change their ways.
Rebellious daughter April offers to host family Thanksgiving dinner in her grubby Lower East Side apartment.
Join a lineup of rock superstars as they celebrate The Band’s famous 1976 farewell performance.

Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) is no victim: He fights back – with a vengeance! After beginning a new life in L.A., Kersey's daughter is viciously assaulted. Now, he won't rest until he tracks the assailants down...and puts them all in the ground!

A battle-weary Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) longs to leave his fighting days behind him. But when he arrives in New York to visit a friend and finds him brutally attacked, the silent avenger must wage war again in this no-holds-barred thriller!

Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) is on a mission to take down the L.A. drug trade after his girlfriend's teenage daughter tragically dies of an overdose. He's armed and dangerous...and mad as hell in this take-no-prisoners, pulse-pounding thriller.

programmes.t: Death Wish V: The Face Of Death
programmes.d: Former vigilante Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) has moved back to New York and is leading a quiet life. But when his beautiful fiancee (Lesley-Anne Down) is killed, once again upholding the law becomes his way of life...and this time it's for good!

In this nail-biting action film, when an aging hitman (Charles Bronson) takes on an eager apprentice (Jan-Michael Vincent) they become an unmatchable team of killers...until the pupil's ruthlessness puts the two on a deadly collision course!

Cinema tough guy Charles Bronson stars as Majestyk, an ex-con and Vietnam vet, whose efforts to run a farm are thwarted by narrow-minded locals and corrupt cops. But when a Mafia hitman destroys his crop, the farmer's fuse is finally blown.

A championship title, a huge cash award, and his son's love -- the greatest prize of all -- are at stake when Lincoln Hawk battles his strongest enemy for everything he has ever wanted. Sylvester Stallone stars in this powerful and exciting film!
In this action-packed sequel, Kevin Sorbo discovers the quiet town he grew up in is now overrun by a violent gang. And it's up to him to take it back!
Dwayne Johnson stars as the most towering myth of all time, revealing the man behind the legend in this bold reimaging of the famed Hercules!

The invasion has begun! Patrick Swayze, C. Thomas Howell, Lea Thompson and Charlie Sheen wage unremitting guerilla warfare in defense of their parents, their friends, their town and their country when Communist invaders storm their hometown.

Charlie Sheen, Michael Biehn and Bill Paxton are three of America's finest Navy commandos. Sent to rescue the crew of a U.S. aircraft carrying Stinger missiles seized by Mideast terrorists, they're thrust onto the frontline of an explosive conflict!

Political extremists have taken innocent people hostage…and only super-soldiers Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin and The Delta Force can rescue them in this explosive adventure filled with wall-to-wall action! Martin Balsam and Shelley Winters also star.

Chuck Norris is in peak form in this explosive action/adventure that brings back one of his most unforgettable characters, Delta Force Colonel Scott McCoy, for a daring mission to destroy a deadly drug cartel led by the ruthless Billy Drago!

Breaker! Breaker! stars Chuck Norris at his butt-kicking best as a trucker on a mission to locate his kidnapped brother and bring down a corrupt Judge (George Murdock) who may just have played a role in the disappearance.

Chuck Norris is back in this action-packed martial arts showcase co-starring the legendary Lee Van Cleef. Norris takes on his adoptive brother and a training camp where terrorists are being taught the secret killing techniques of the ninja!
American servicemen are still being held captive in Vietnam – and it's up to one man to bring them home in this blistering, fast-paced action/adventure starring martial arts superstar Chuck Norris.

Chuck Norris returns as James Braddock in this action-packed prequel to the original hit film. As war rages in Vietnam, Braddock and his men are captured and imprisoned. With fists and sheer courage, he must become an army of one to save his men.

When Colonel James Braddock (Chuck Norris, "Missing in Action") is told that his wife and 12-year-old son are still alive in Communist Vietnam, he mounts a one-man assault to free them…armed with the latest high-tech firepower, of course!

Two hapless soldiers of misfortune (Chuck Norris, Louis Gossett Jr.) meet a beautiful girl (Melody Anderson) with a map to a lost gold mine and decide to have one last shot at striking it rich. But the trail to the treasure is no yellow brick road!

Chuck Norris is Lone Wolf McQuade, a Texas Ranger feared by outlaws and respected by other lawmen. When McQuade uncovers a gun smuggling operation, the action explodes, with McQuade wreaking havoc on all those who come between him and the law.

An army of terrorist mercenaries led by Soviet agent Rostov (Richard Lynch) catches America unprepared and makes it into a war zone. Only one man can stem the rising tide of violence: retired agent and martial arts expert Matt Hunter (Chuck Norris).

To restore the life of his fiancee, who was decapitated in an automobile accident, a brilliant surgeon tries to find a suitable body to attach to her head, which he keeps alive and locked in a dungeon. But nothing will stop her from getting revenge!

Scientist Patrick Corey has a hideous hobby - he keeps brains alive! But when the brain of dead murderer W.H. Donovan falls into his possession, he finds that it has a mind of its own�and is controlling him through telepathic messages!
Two young lovers are stranded overnight in a van, unaware they’re outside the mansion of a revenous vampire who is feeding on any trespassers!
It's a love story with bite when a revived Count Yorga roams the city in search of new blood…until he finds a girl to share eternity with!

The eternally cool William Marshall puts a fresh spin on the age-old legend of the vampire, condemned to wander the Earth with an insatiable lust for blood in "Blacula," often credited as the first African American horror film.

Brought back to the world of the living by a voodoo ceremony Blacula (William Marshall) is loosed with insatiable bloodlust upon the population of a small community in the Louisiana back country. Pam Grier also stars in this scintillating sequel
When a nightclub entrepreneur gets taken out by the mob, his girlfriend calls upon a voodoo high priest to carry out an unholy plan for revenge.
Suppose a stranger told you that your daughter was his child reincarnated. Anthony Hopkins and Marsha Mason star in this hair-raising occult thriller.
Widowed police psychologist Cal Jamison (Martin Sheen) is forced to deal with a series of ritualistic child murders perpetrated by a rogue cult.
Scott Bakula stars as a detective who gets more than he bargains for in this thriller that rips apart the boundaries between the illusion and magic.
After being bitten on the neck during a night of passion, an agent is convinced he's a vampire.
Mark wants to go all the way. His girlfriend won’t, but he meets a beautiful vampire who will! The problem? He’s starting to feel a little batty.
Dracula finds a victim with the perfect blood to resurrect his bloodsucking bride, but an error results in an unexpected change to his beloved.
Dracula flees Europe and ends up in a small California town. And his ravenous thirst is quickly turning the Golden State into…the ghoulish state!
Basil Rathbone, Bela Lugosi, Lon Chaney, Jr. and John Carradine star in this terrifying horror classic about a brain surgeon's unorthodox experiments.
In this ghoulish tale, Ray Milland stars as a painter whose obsessive fear of being buried alive compels him to build himself a tomb with a view!

programmes.t: X: The Man With The X-Ray Eyes
programmes.d: In this cult-classic, a driven scientist discovers that his x-ray vision formula brings with it incredible powers…and incredible temptations.
Shelley Winters puts the Grande in Grande Dame Guignol in director Curtis Harrington's atmospheric, suspenseful and surprisingly moving cult chiller.
In this cult-classic thriller, Kay Lenz and Shelley Winters star as a co-ed and the witchy head of a sorority who has special plans for the new girl.

A 300-year old vampire (rock star Adam Ant) tries to "re-humanize" after falling in love with a beautiful "mortal."  His attempts are thwarted, however, by his jealous vampire lover and his new love's jealous fiancee.  Can an ancient vampire find love and happiness in the 20th century?
Every 22 years, a jinxed vampire is fated to lose his beloved at the hands of a crazy pirate. But with his new band, he’s going to end the curse!

Five years after the massacre at Camp Arawak, Angela is now working at Camp Rolling Hills. She's still crazy...for camping and good clean fun, that is. But Angela draws the line at bad behavior and she's going to teach some naughty campers a lesson!

Under inept new management, Camp Rolling Hills is now Camp New Horizons and it's the ideal setting for a notorious psychopath like Angela Baker to do what she does best, eliminating "immoral" teenagers with everything from a knife to a lawnmower.

As a gang of brutal gunmen forcefully gain control of Sheridan City, its terrified citizens hire the notorious "town-tamer" Clint Tollinger to help them. But Tollinger operates in his own way...so things could get a lot worse before they get better!

Lee Marvin gives a spellbinding performance as Harry Spikes, a wounded outlaw who appears as a romantic figure to three impressionable youths (Gary Grimes, Ron Howard and Charles Martin Smith) and who he enlists them as his bank-robbing partners.

In this comedy western, Lee Marvin plays an ex-trail scout, and Oliver Reed is his half Native American partner who decide to settle accounts with a former partner who cheated them out of stolen money. But the partner has now joined high society!

In this hilarious western spoof, insurance broker Milford Farnsworth (Bob Hope) unwittingly sells a life insurance policy worth $100,000 to the infamous Jesse James. Now, he has to figure out how to keep the deadliest outlaw in history alive!
Steve Martin, Chevy Chase and Martin Short are three wild and crazy caballeros in this comedy adventure that’s a fiesta of fun.

Charles Bronson plays Graham Dorsey, a bank robber who, through a series of twists and turns finds himself the object of national adoration. A beautiful widow, Amanda Starbuck (Jill Ireland) is responsible for creating this myth.
John Wayne teams with William Holden and director John Ford for this rousing tale of one of the most daring cavalry exploits in all of history.

John Wayne, Montgomery Clift and Walter Brennan give stellar performances in Howard Hawks' epic masterpiece as a self-made cattle baron (Wayne) and his adopted son (Clift) risk everything to drive their herd across the treacherous Chisholm Trail.

John Wayne produces, directs and stars in this retelling of the Alamo, a battle in which 185 men joined together against an army of 7,000. Filmed entirely in Texas, "The Alamo" is a visually stunning and historically accurate celebration of courage.

Screen legend Gary Cooper demonstrates why he will always be remembered as one of the most authentic stars of the screen. Capable yet vulnerable, Cooper's portrayal of a former outlaw whose past returns to haunt him ranks among his very best.
Five Civil War outlaws must brave hostile Comanche territory – and a cunning woman – to hijack a stagecoach carrying a traitor...and $30,000 in gold!

Seeking a fresh start, Bat Masterson (Joel McCrea) rolls into Dodge City with a chip on his shoulder and a gun on his hip. But soon, his mysterious past will catch up with him when an old friend calls in a favor...one that might cost him his life!

In this compelling and imaginative western, a peace-loving Swedish seaman is forced to take on an entire frontier town when he discovers a ruthless oil prospector has been forcing farmers to sell their land...or pay for it with their lives.

When an outlaw is shot during a heist and left for dead by his partners - who take his money and his woman - he sets out to track them down. And when he catches up with them, he'll have to rely on his wits...as much as the loaded gun in his holster!

Screen legend Yul Brynner turns in a magnificent performance as a gunfighter who must do battle with his most formidable adversary - his own conscience - in this gripping, double-barreled western full of surprise twists and colorful villainy.

Starring Yul Brynner and a stellar supporting cast that includes Robert Fuller, Warren Oates and Claude Akins, this classic western adventure follows the legendary Magnificent Seven as they thunder through Mexico to face the shootout of their lives!

In this thrilling follow-up to one of the greatest Western sagas in film history, notorious desperado Chris Adams (George Kennedy) is offered a huge reward to free a young Mexican revolutionary from prison…in the midst of the Mexican Revolution.

When his wife is killed, Marshal Chris Adams (Lee Van Cleef) discovers that a ruthless horde of marauders have killed all the men -- and will come back for the women -- in a nearby border town...unless The Magnificent Seven can stop them!

The body has inherent systems to slow and even reverse aging. When you activate these systems you increase stem cell production, reduce inflammation, increase antioxidant enzymes, build muscle, lose fat, and increase cognitive capacity.

Now that we understand the root causes of aging, how do we actually address the hallmarks of aging? What are the levers we have to optimize our health and longevity? Because medicine has it all wrong. We don't need to treat disease. When we focus on fostering optimal health, disease goes away as a side effect.

There are basic fundamental ways we can optimize our health, starting with topics we’ve already discussed, like eating well and exercising appropriately. But, just as important for health and longevity is the need to rest, relax, and connect with each other. Community is essential, and being of service to one another can help you heal.

Too much stress will take you down, but the right amount of stress at the right time can activate your body's repair and healing mechanisms. What natural elements stress our system in such a way that it then activates the body to heal?

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Grief is the death of something—someone, a relationship, a job, or a dream. There’s no timeline, and you cannot heal what you do not feel. Guided by David Kessler, this course helps you navigate your river of grief, honor your unique process, and find a path toward healing.

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Grief is about the heart, but the mind shapes the story we tell. While you can’t change the facts of loss, you can change the narrative, honor old wounds, and choose words that guide you toward growth, meaning, and deeper connection to joy and healing.

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Loss can make you feel powerless, but grief is your work and your power. David Kessler guides you to grieve fully on your terms, honor your unique process, and reclaim agency over your healing, showing that you can live fully while holding your pain with strength.

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Your survival mind is wired to protect you from pain, but after loss it can spiral into worry and worst-case thinking. Learn the science of grief, how repetitive thoughts form deep mental pathways, and how to rewire your mind to heal and grow.

Day 1 introduces the practice of centering through the breath. When the mind drifts to regret or worry, we gently return—again and again. This meditation teaches concentration, presence, and compassion, reminding us that healing isn’t in never wandering, but in beginning again.

Day 2 invites us to examine the stories we tell about our worth, limits, and lives. By recognizing conditioned habits and outdated coping tools, we reconnect with our power of choice. This lesson reminds us that change is always possible—and that we can meet life with renewed care and curiosity.

Day 3 focuses on meeting anger and fear with compassion rather than resistance. By paying gentle attention to difficult emotions, we learn they are not bad—only painful when they define us. Using the breath as an anchor, we develop a kinder, wiser relationship to our inner experience.

Day 4 explores opening to joy by intentionally taking in the good. We examine habits of threat, perfectionism, and resistance, and practice savoring what’s nourishing and life-giving. Through gentle curiosity, this lesson shows how joy can restore resilience and help us meet life with more ease.

programmes.t: Austria salvaje: la fuerza del agua
programmes.d: Un viaje opulento y cinematográfico desde el mundo helado y cubierto de nieve de las tierras altas, con sus imponentes glaciares, cascadas rugientes y torrentes de montaña embravecidos, atravesando los últimos bosques primigenios hasta llegar al cálido lago estepario.

programmes.t: El Caribe Salvaje - Los ritmos de la vida
programmes.d: Las costas e islas coralinas del Caribe, formadas por criaturas vivas y por restos de criaturas que alguna vez estuvieron vivas, son ahora un laberinto de vida. Cada año, en un asombroso despliegue sincronizado de desove de coral, los "animales flor" recolonizan los arrecifes.

El autobús cebra se embarca en una misión final para encontrar al último miembro de los 7 grandes, el gran tiburón blanco, que partieron hacia la isla de los pájaros para observar nidos y pájaros recién nacidos.

En este episodio, los niños aprenden la verdad sobre la historia de su khoisan. De vuelta en el autobús cebra, la tensión aumenta cuando la carretera está bloqueada, mis elefantes y pronto quedan atrapados por una manada.
El impacto que el mundo moderno ha tenido en la recóndita vida salvaje de las Islas Canarias.

programmes.t: El Caribe Salvaje - Los ritmos de la vida
programmes.d: Acción espectacular en el paraíso. Desde la secuencia inicial de una tortuga marina atrapada por un tiburón tigre, queda claro que ningún animal, cazador o presa -por encima o por debajo del agua- puede atravesar la vida sin una estrategia de supervivencia.
Gran parte de la selva que cubre Centro y Sudamérica se conoce como selva tropical. En este entorno cálido y húmedo, la vida florece.
