Jhon Fredy y Miguel Ángel adoptaron una niña, pero el Colegio Americano de Bogotá los rechazó por ser una familia homoparental. Fabio Meneses y Xiomy Díaz sufrieron en terapias de conversión. Andrés Felipe Arboleda fue asesinado por discriminación en Caldas.

Estafas de vehículos usados en Colombia afectan a numerosos compradores. Desde autos embargados hasta ventas de vehículos robados, los casos incluyen varios imputados, como Norman Eduardo Serrano y Óscar Fabián Rodríguez.
El miedo a las represalias ha impedido que las víctimas denuncien delitos en Colombia.

En 2016, en Socorro, Santander, Yesenia Bernal fue asesinada para robarle a su bebé recién nacido. Su amiga Edilsa María Díaz, tras perder su propio embarazo y temiendo perder a su pareja, fingió estar embarazada y planeó el crimen junto a Juan Carlos Vega para apropiarse de la niña. Ambos fueron capturados y condenados: Edilsa a 35 años y Juan Carlos a una pena similar.

En 2009, Islanis fue asesinada a los 21 años. El principal sospechoso, alias "Betún", reveló que el verdadero autor intelectual era Jonatán Pérez, un cabo del Ejército, quien la mató al enterarse de su embarazo, temiendo el impacto en su carrera militar. En 2011, Pérez fue condenado a 40 años de prisión por homicidio agravado.

EL caso de un asesinato planeado por una pareja, para quitar del medio a un humilde carpintero con el objetivo quedarse con su fortuna. Hoy los hijos, del ahora difunto, exigen justicia para que los verdaderos culpables paguen las consecuencias de sus actos.

En Cajamarca, Tolima, el líder ambientalista César García fue asesinado frente a su familia tras oponerse a la minera AngloGold Ashanti. Aunque se sospechó de un vínculo con la empresa, las autoridades lo descartaron. Una carta de suicidio reveló que el verdadero autor fue Álvaro Meléndez, vecino con quien García tuvo un litigio de tierras. Meléndez permanece detenido esperando juicio.
Gina Paola Manrique, empresaria de Neiva, fue hallada muerta en un aparente suicidio. Tras investigar, el CTI determinó que fue feminicidio.

Melany Amaya, de 16 años, desapareció tras asistir a una fiesta electrónica en Medellín en junio de 2018. Tras siete días de búsqueda, una llamada anónima alertó a su madre. Su cuerpo fue hallado en un potrero del sector "El Calvario".
Mario está demandando a la psíquica del vecindario, Lydia, por $30,000 y la imposición negligente de angustia emocional después de prometer eliminar su maldición ... por una tarifa.
Giselle está demandando a su padre, Albert Martinez, por angustia emocional y $145,000 por el costo de cancelar su boda.
Miguel está demandando a su ex novia, Jasmine, por la totalidad de los $5 millones que ella ganó a través de un boleto instantáneo que compró con su tarjeta de crédito.
Guadalupe está demandando a Thomas, el dueño de una tienda de vestidos de Quinceañera, por dolor y sufrimiento más el costo del vestido que es de $4,500.

A los 16 años, Liliana Cáceres se hizo famosa en Barranquilla al fingir un embarazo de nueve bebés, tras enterarse de la infidelidad de su novio con su mejor amiga. Su mentira, que incluso llegó a oídos de Gabriel García Márquez, se descubrió al someterse a exámenes médicos. Tras el escándalo, huyó a Cartagena, rehízo su vida y hoy sueña con ayudar a niñas embarazadas de verdad.

Cinco años después del homicidio de Alonso Orjuela, dueño de Surtifruver, su exesposa Cecilia Rueda y su socio Mauricio Parra hablan por primera vez ante cámaras. Ambos estuvieron presos —ella acusada de complicidad, él de ser testaferro de las FARC— pero fueron liberados por vencimiento de términos. Ahora denuncian un montaje judicial y afirman tener pruebas de que no fue un crimen pasional.
Diamond asegura que SP le rogó un hijo, Jenell dice que él quería otro con ella, pero SP lo niega todo. ¿Debe Tone $3,000 en manutención? ¿Es Jacob el padre del hijo de Tyler y Matina? ¡Hoy en MAURY!

¡Cartel se niega a creer que una aventura de una noche con una amiga de la escuela secundaria, Brittany, resultó en su embarazo! Entonces, ¿Juan y Clinton son los papás de sus hijos? Además, ¡Kelly necesita saber qué primo fue el padre de su bebé!

En el episodio de hoy de MAURY, estos hombres dicen que saben que la prueba de paternidad demostrará lo que siempre han sabido: que no son padres de los hijos de las mujeres que los trajeron aquí. ¡Ellas están listas para demostrarles que están equivocados!

Sherry fue atacada a los 15 años y se escapó de su casa. Quiere que Steve la ayude a reunirse con su madre. Después, la hija adolescente de Dawn, Cathy, dio a luz recientemente, pero vive asustada por el desempleado e inestable padre del bebé, Nick.
Morgan dejó de ser animadora tras el acoso por una foto manipulada; ella y su madre confrontan a los culpables. Luego, Kedrick acusa a Sonya de infidelidad pocos meses después de iniciar su relación.
Connie busca la ayuda de Steve para evitar que su hija Angel se case con Matt, a quien acusa de golpearla y causarle graves lesiones. ¿Logrará convencerla de dejar esta relación abusiva?
Jerry tiene 58 años y ha pasado por tres cambios importantes. Actualmente está felizmente comprometido con una mujer que se llama Joy y habla de su pasada confusión en cuanto al género.
Josh quiere recuperar a su ex, pero sus engaños resurgen; Deja confronta a su novio por su propuesta indecente a dos strippers gemelas; Misti se entera de que su novio la está engañando nuevamente.

Je''nier tiene un secreto difícil de contar a Preston. Después, ¡son Nikki y Nikky las que persiguen al mismo hombre! ¿Ganará Nikki o Nikky el corazón de Kevin? ¿Kevin merece el amor de alguna de las dos mujeres?
Kiki quiere casarse con el hombre que la engañó con su prima; Tayshun culpa a su novia por su infidelidad; una estrella porno quiere que el chico que le gusta represente una escena con ella.
Tanisha enfrenta a su novio y la bailarina; Brandi recurre a extremos para casarse; Ashley enseña a su colega la etiqueta stripper.

Casos de negligencia y posibles abusos bajo el cuidado del ICBF exponen un sistema en crisis: muertes sin esclarecer, custodias fallidas y maltrato en hogares infantiles plantean graves dudas sobre la protección real de la infancia en Colombia.
La adicción de Juan Sebastián, abogado de 35 años, a las apuestas electrónicas lo llevó a perder casi todo y a un intento de suicidio.

La ira al volante se ha convertido en una patología cotidiana que afecta a miles de colombianos. Desde accidentes hasta homicidios, los desencadenantes de esta furia son múltiples, pero la empatía podrían prevenir tragedias en las vías.

En Colombia, las muertes por accidentes viales por exceso de velocidad y embriaguez, siguen creciendo. A pesar de las tragedias, muchos conductores iresponsables quedan impunes, las leyes no logran frenar la creciente cifra de víctimas.

En Aguachica, un joven prometió grandes ganancias con criptomonedas, pero desapareció con el dinero de los inversionistas. En Bogotá, Daniel Gómez ofreció rentabilidades del 8% con su empresa Taurex, pero tampoco cumplió. La criptomoneda Daily Cop también dejó a miles sin su dinero. Las estafas suman millones de dólares.

Fernanda, Marleny y Jonathan son víctimas de préstamos digitales que se convierten en cobros intimidantes. Séptimo Día investiga Call Centers que usan tácticas de intimidación para cobrar deudas. Las autoridades y expertos advierten sobre los riesgos de estas aplicaciones.
Los padres luchan por mantener a sus hijos adolescentes y preadolescentes a salvo de los peligros de Internet.

En Itagüí Antioquia, dos hermanos adolecentes son asesinados en su propia casa por su tío, quién al parecer sufría ataques de esquizofrenia. Cuatro meses después del homicidio, el asesino es capturado y recluido en la cárcel de máxima seguridad en Itagúi, pagando una condena de 54 años de prisión, mientras que los padres de los menores rehacen su vida por caminos separados.

En 2011, en Anzoátegui, Tolima, los gemelos Diego y Juan Sebastián, de 7 años, fueron secuestrados por Pedro Andrés Laserna, expareja de su madre Mariela, tras ella terminar la relación y denunciarlo por violencia. Laserna exigió dinero y su regreso a cambio de los niños, pero finalmente los asesinó. Fue condenado a 50 años de prisión por secuestro extorsivo agravado y homicidio agravado.

Janeth soñaba con una vida mejor, pero fue asesinada por su esposo celoso en medio de promesas de refugio en Canadá. Sus hijos quedaron bajo la custodia de Carlos, mientras sus cenizas volvían a su ciudad natal.
En La Montañita, Caquetá, Jhon Jairo Marín rehace su vida con Yineth Mosquera, quien, celosa del hijo de su pareja, Esneider, termina atentando contra la vida del menor.
Edenis Barrera Benavides, líder social y voluntaria de la Defensa Civil, fue brutalmente asesinada en 2014.

En Guarne, Antioquia, Jaime Iván Martínez fue capturado por el homicidio de su esposa María Gladis Arango, su amiga Natalia García, y sus dos hijos de 5 y 8 años, ahorcados en 2015. El "Monstruo de Guarne" confesó los crímenes, motivados por el rechazo de su esposa al querer terminar la relación. Fue condenado a 42 años de prisión tras un acuerdo entre la fiscalía y su defensa.
Alexa está demandando a su novio de un año y medio por cancelar abruptamente el viaje de su vida porque necesitaba traer a su hijo de 7 años.

Barbara demanda al club de striptease de Emilio por 30.000 dólares, alegando negligencia y angustia emocional. Ella afirma haber sufrido un latigazo cervical por la actuación de Jackson y una silla que se derrumbó. Emilio niega su responsabilidad, citando la seguridad y el consumo de alcohol de Bárbara.
Wilbur y su esposa, Lucia, están demandando a la hermana de Wilbur, Jennifer, por $200,000 después de que su hijo quedó fuera del testamento de su abuela.
Gabriella está demandando a su ex empleadora, Jaqueline Mendoza, por $600,000 por angustia mental y despido injustificado luego de sufrir un ataque de pánico durante una celebración de la empresa.

Samantha demanda a Elizabeth y al investigador privado Ricardo por 40.000 dólares por acusaciones falsas. Elizabeth contrató a Ricardo para investigar al marido de Samantha, pero acusó erróneamente a Samantha. Samantha denuncia acoso y difamación. Elizabeth y Ricardo niegan responsabilidad.

En 1987, Jhonatan Jiménez, de 3 años, fue secuestrado en Bogotá por un conocido de la familia. Treinta y dos años después, su hermano Juan lo encontró en Noruega mediante una prueba de ADN. Ahora llamado Jhon Erick, se reencontraron y él regresó a Colombia, donde su familia le organizó una emotiva bienvenida. Juan, actor y documentalista, ahora narra esta historia de dolor, injusticia y reencuentro familiar.
Porfirio Ramírez, 'El Aeropirata', secuestró un avión en 2005, motivado por desesperación y deseos de hablar con el presidente Uribe. Tras años en prisión y actuación en cine, lucha con su destino.
¿La esposa del pastor Terry lo engañó con 200 hombres diferentes? A continuación, Naomi quiere averiguar si su prometido, Jesse, es un infiel. ¿Qué revelarán los resultados en Maury hoy?

Toni, Quintin y su madre regresan para averiguar quién es el padre de su hijo. ¡Esta vez se preguntarán si Toni fue infiel! ¡Jenny tiene que saber si el padre de su hijo es su marido Matt o su amigo! Finalmente, ¿Vivian terminará la búsqueda de su hijo que ya lleva 30 años?

Stephanie se somete a una prueba de detector de mentiras para demostrar que es fiel a su novio; una pareja comprometida se acusa mutuamente de engaños; Maurice quiere demostrarle a su novia que es leal.

After his rifle misfires during a close encounter with a bear, Jim approaches a blacksmith to suggest a different kind of knife.

A road accident has given a young driver some small cuts, and Mike and Eamon then check for deeper injuries. An elderly woman’s dizzy symptoms puzzle single-responder Andrew.

The Royal Melbourne Emergency Department is non-stop 24/7. Dr Mark Putland examines what’s left of a limestone quarry worker’s arm after it was mangled in a machine. Dr Assiya Halid checks a man for broken and dislocated bones after he collided with a car on his way to a date. Dr Jonathan Papson works carefully to remove a screw from a man’s thumb after a home DIY mishap. Dr Luke de la Rue fears for an unborn baby after a 30-week pregnant mother was hit by a bus.

The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department is ready to help people on their worst days. Dr Emma West fears a motor-cross rider has life-changing injuries after coming off her bike. Time is critical as Dr Scott Taylor’s unresponsive patient deteriorates with a suspected brain bleed. Dr Tristan Harding must straighten a young farmer’s severely dislocated ankle before the blood supply cuts off. Dr Mya Cubitt treats a cheerful 103-year-old legend’s leg for a nasty infection.

At the Royal Melbourne Hospital, Dr Michael Dunne and Dr Jonathan Papson urgently need answers for one of the sickest patients they’ve seen. The 47-year-old man can’t breathe with suspected pneumonia, but something else is going on. A woman in severe back pain after slipping on concrete at work can’t feel anything when Dr Ilya Kardailsky prods her side with a needle. Dr Michelle Thornhill examines a teenager in agony after he fell five metres onto his back while riding a dirt bike.

At The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s ED, doctors Tinnie Chang and Caitlin Young fear a cyclist has potentially life-changing injuries. The man is in intense pain with protruding broken bones after he collided with a ute. Doctors Terry Kane and Bjorn Makein see warning signs when they examine a 30-year-old man with severe chest pain who has a history of collapsed lungs. Dr Emma West suspects a happy older man is hiding his injuries after a motorbike crash, but scans reveal the truth.

At The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s ED, doctors Jonathan Papson and Emma West struggle to remove a glove that’s embedded in a construction worker’s mangled hand. Dr Tristan Harding and nurse Tanya Wallace carefully check the spine of a man in agony after he fell off a roof. Dr Assiya Halid examines the shocking injuries of a driver who smashed his lovingly restored car into a wall. Nurse Practitioner Paul Casey and Dr Jana Alexander delicately remove something painful from a woman’s ear.

At The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department, Dr Emma West is on high alert treating a woman’s life-threatening injuries from a car accident. Dr Sarah Whitelaw isn’t sure what she’ll find under the bandages on a man whose foot was slashed by a lawn mower blade. Dr Jonathan Papson prepares for the worst after a paraglider, who is also a nurse, fell 30 metres and landed on his head. Dr Tsung Chung guides Junior Dr Norah O’Sullivan as she checks on a man who’s vomiting blood.

At The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department, Drs Bec Hughes and Fahad “Faz” Yousif look after a man who fell off a ladder while pruning his lemon tree and landed on his back. Dr James Williams fears for a young cheerleader who landed on her head during training. Dr Michael Dunne expects the worst when he unwraps the blood-soaked bandages from a man’s arm after it was mangled in a car accident. Dr Jonathan Papson admires a festival goer’s mohawk as he fixes his shoulder.

The Emergency Department at The Royal Melbourne Hospital handles traumas of all kinds. Dr Emma West is on high alert for a cyclist who’s been trapped under a tram. A 21-year-old with a history of sinus issues is bleeding profusely from the back of his throat, and Dr Jonathan Papson worries he could choke. Dr Michelle Thornhill fears an older man might lose his independence after he fell off a roof. Dr David Sparkhall and Dr Michael Dunne treat a motorbike rider with a badly smashed-up knee.

A young woman arrives via helicopter to the Royal Melbourne Hospital’s emergency department after her car slammed into a tree. Dr Jonathan Papson worries she’ll have life-changing injuries as her old car lacked modern safety features. Dr David Sparkhall fears the worst as he takes the tourniquet off a handyman’s blood-soaked arm. Dr Tristan Harding expects to find multiple injuries in a man who’s fallen three metres off a balcony. Dr Emma West calms a young mum who’s cut though her hand.

Patients arrive at all hours to the Emergency Department at The Royal Melbourne Hospital. With a helicopter on the way, ED assistant Sandra Nash checks the landing pad to ensure stray debris doesn’t become a missile. Dr Tinnie Chang’s patient has severe head injuries after a horror fall off a truck. Nurse Lucy Stranger and Dr Zaheer Jayhoon fear something sinister could be happening to an otherwise cheerful woman with chest pain. Dr Bec Hughes’s young patient has puzzling abdominal pain.

Every second counts as Paramedics respond to traumas every day. Hannah’s first shift as a MICA Paramedic puts her new skills to the test, after a woman in a store collapses, stops breathing and has no heartbeat. Sally and Olivia worry a small boy has a head injury after a fall at Grandma’s. Single-responder Dan needs to extract a P-Plate driver out of a crashed car, carefully. Aaron and Laura help a young footballer who’s smashed her face during a game - the school dance is two weeks away!

Every second counts as Paramedics respond to everyday people having their worst day. Daniel rushes to a woman having a life-threatening allergic reaction from a takeaway. She’s struggling to breathe and is terrified. Long-time workmates and housemates Sam and Chris love a laugh, but switch to serious mode after an accident in the busy nightclub district. Georgia and rookie Ben worry a young mother-to-be is about to miscarry twins. Carlos and Nhi race to stop a little boy from choking on food.

Every second counts as Paramedics respond to people having their worst days. Bill rushes to a woman whose heart is racing out of control. Chris and Sam rescue a dirtbike rider, but the ‘green whistle’ makes the patient laugh away the pain. Nhi and Carlos fear the worst as they arrive at a collision between car and bus. While Laura gives a cyclist the all-clear, Aaron happily rides the man’s pushbike home. A stoic 70- year-old man who fell out of a tree with a chainsaw worries Ben and Georgia.

Paramedic Bill races to a man having seizures. The patient is going downhill fast and could lash out at the very people trying to save him. Former horse rider Hannah fears an elite equestrian might never walk again after an horrific accident. The woman fell during a jump, and the horse rolled on top of her. Olivia and Sally become medical detectives as they examine a woman having a potential stroke. Chris and Sam know every second counts as they rush to a distraught woman struggling to breathe.

Intensive Care Paramedic Dan is in a race against time treating a woman who feels like her heart is leaping out of her chest. Laura and Aaron confront a nightmare situation after a young man crashes into a tree. It’s a chaotic scene and the driver is trapped. Nhi and Carlos have to break in to an eldery woman’s home; she’s in agony after a fall and can’t get to the door to let them in. Hannah comes to the rescue of a student who’s crash landed during a high jump and could have spinal injuries.

Nhi and Carlos under pressure to bring a drug overdose patient back from the brink of death. Laura and Aaron are on their way to one job, when they come across a motorbike crash. The rider’s horrific injuries are so bad, he may never walk again. Hannah rushes to an elderly man virtually suffocating from fluid on his lungs while his beloved sweetheart fears the worst. Ben and Tarnya apply their superhero skills to a toddler who’s struggling to breathe.

A young Dad suddenly suffers frightening seizures while driving his wife and baby. Intensive care paramedic, Dan can’t believe the family are still alive. Aaron and Laura treat a serial daredevil with serious injuries after a spectacular crash from his dirt bike. Chris and Sam challenge each other to slip ‘the word of the day’ into their next case. Solo responder Bill fights heavy traffic to help a diabetic grandmother who has collapsed at home and is not responding.

Bill holds a young mother’s life in his hands, as her heart races out of control. Aaron is ready for anything as he resets a netballer’s shoulder, but is he prepared for the cheeky sportswoman’s banter? Sam has ‘man-flu’, so Chris teams up with Laura for the first time. Together they rush to help an elderly Parkinson’s patient with a growing infection that could turn septic. Aaron later joins Dan to rescue a collapsed man with critical head injuries, found in a pool of blood in a car park.

A confronting case for Nhi and Carlos as they are called to a woman running in front of traffic. The woman is in crisis and suddenly jumps out of the ambulance as the paramedics try to help her. Dan helps a star footballer who’s busted his leg at training. Sally and Olivia fear their elderly patient is having a heart attack and new dad, Bill races to a first time Mum whose baby could be having a life-threatening allergic reaction.

A terrified patient with a failing heart has Aaron and Laura on high alert. Dan is called to a stubborn local celebrity. The 79-year-old character needs to be in hospital, but doesn’t trust doctors. Nhi and Carlos share their school memories on the way to to help a teen who’s crashed landed on a basketball court. Chris and Sam meet their oldest ever patient. The stoic 104-year-old Nelly has terrible face injuries after a fall in her house but still gives the boys her secret to longevity.

Every second counts as Bill battles to save a woman with catastrophic head injuries after she fell four metres through a roof onto a concrete floor. Nhi and Carlos meet a delightful patient who’s still smiling after breaking her arm during a family lunch. Laura and Aaron rush to a mum who’s slumped over in her car and is unresponsive. Sally and Olivia handle a lethargic toddler with extra care, after a big bump at the playground.

A sudden collapse shocks Olivia and Sally as their patient suddenly appears to be having a heart attack. Carlos and Nhi fear for their safety as a volatile woman lashes out in the back of the ambulance. Chris and Sam’s protective instincts kick in for a teenage patient who was attacked on his way to school. It’s déjà vu for Laura as she and Aaron are called to a patient she’s treated before and desperately needs her help again.

A baby in a hurry has Bill concerned the mother will be delivering in the back of his ambulance. To add to the pressure, this is a high-risk pregnancy. A guest of honour has collapsed in front of her family at a milestone birthday celebration. Nhi and Carlos arrive at the crowded party as four generations of worried relatives look on. Aaron and Laura rush to an amputee in agony. The man tripped over after grabbing a burger and managed to dial for help with his nose!

At Australia’s Royal Melbourne Hospital, Dr Emma West faces a dangerous situation with an aggressive stabbing victim. The patient will die without help, but he’s putting up a fight. Drs Jonathan Papson and Mya Cubitt race to save the life of a young man whose car slammed into a pole. Dr Mark Putland treats a factory worker who’s in shock after being confronted with his horrific life-changing injuries. A heavily pregnant young woman presents a challenge for Dr Michelle Thornhill.

A gunshot victim arrives at The Royal Melbourne Hospital under police guard. Dr Sarah Whitelaw fears the patient could die from his injuries, but the shooter is still at large, posing a risk. Dr Jonathan Papson treats a football player who could bleed to death from kidney damage, after an on-field collision. Dr Michael Dunne and nurse Lucy Stranger assess a pregnant car crash patient who can’t feel her baby move. Dr Michelle races to the waiting room after a woman mysteriously collapses.

Dr Fiona Nicholson uses her reassuring bedside manner on a young man with a racing heart and spiking blood pressure - but she’ll have to stop his heart beating in order to save him. A patient with a gruesome head wound has Dr Sarah Whitelaw on full alert, and unseen internal injuries could make things even worse. Nurse Julia Hoiles helps a smitten young couple who spend their first date in emergency. Dr Michael Dunne treats a nurse-to-be who has smashed her leg in a car accident.

A spate of road accidents puts pressure on the emergency team. Dr Mark Putland tries to help a car crash patient, but the man appears to be hiding something suspicious in his underpants. Dr Miriam Yassa examines a cheerful 82-year-old biker with fractures, who suddenly takes a turn for the worse. Dr Emma West’s road trauma victim could have internal bleeding, but the cure could do more harm than good. Nurse Yasna Cardoza helps a patient who collapses after cutting his thumb on a coffee plunger.

Dr Mark Putland assembles a crack team to save a man with a gunshot wound to the neck with a rare procedure to keep him breathing. Dr Jonathan Papson suspects a surf-coach has a shattered leg from a horror car crash, which could spell the end of the young man’s career. A worker is in agony after a fall on the job, and Dr Sarah Whitelaw and nurse Maddy Whyte fear he has serious spinal injuries. Dr Mya Cubitt heals a former boxer with neat stitches and helps him confront an unpleasant truth.

Nurse Yasna Cardoza’s patient slipped in the shower and his wounds are very deep – but the thought of an operation terrifies him. A gunshot victim has Dr Michael Dunne on high alert, as he examines the man’s bullet-riddled body for injuries. Dr Emma West treats a mum who could lose her fingers after a high-speed car crash. Dr Mya’s patient is in agony after falling from a shipping container. Dr Michelle Thornhill stitches up a young man who walked into a wall while checking his phone.

Split-second events throw lives into chaos. Dr Jonathan Papson’s trauma patient wasn’t wearing a seatbelt when her car rolled, but she’s more worried about what her dad will say. Dr Sarah Whitelaw’s motorcyclist collided with a car and went head-first through a window, and there are grave fears for his brother who was also on the bike. Dr Mya Cubitt’s scared patient has an unstoppable nosebleed, and security crash-tackles a violent man trying to smear blood onto staff.

Dr Steve Pincus’s young patient could lose his hand after a shocking abattoir accident. A severe asthmatic struggles to breathe, but Dr Bjorn Makein suspects another trigger. Air ambulance delivers a quad-bike rider who crashed at high speed, landing on his head, and Dr Michael Dunne fears there could be spinal injuries. Nurse Lucy Stranger’s detective skills and charm are needed for a patient with chest pains. A wayward spider sends a high-speed road crash victim to Dr Jana Alexander.

A life hangs in the balance, as Dr Emma West rushes to meet a critically injured road trauma victim at the helipad. Every moment counts, as the unconscious patient has severe blood loss. Dr Lauren Cohen treats an American schoolboy who plunged 10 metres down a cliff. 20-year-veteran Dr Tom Razga treats the ‘walking wounded’ in triage, reassuring a highly anxious woman who has a small wound. Is Dr Michelle Thornhill’s patient constipated from pasta or is it more serious?

A heavily pregnant young woman has collapsed at a train station platform, falling face-first and landing on her stomach. Dr Miriam Yassa is on high alert for the baby’s welfare, and the cause of the mum-to-be’s collapse. Dr Sarah Whitelaw treats a cyclist after a car hit him from behind. He can’t remember the accident or feel his feet. Support volunteer Jean is on hand for comfort and cups of tea and is a welcome distraction for stressed patients.

Every second counts as Paramedics respond to everyday people having their worst moments. A rider is bucked off her horse and is lying helpless in remote bushland. The only way out is a risky chopper rescue but there is nowhere to land. Ben and his new paramedic partner, Mim rush to a young Mum who’s smashed her elbow at a kid’s roller-skating party and Bill tries to save a teacher having a massive heart attack.

Every second counts as Paramedics respond to emergencies of all kinds. Laura and Aaron prepare for double the complications as a mum with a high-risk pregnancy goes into labour. In a first for the show, cameras follow the patient into hospital not to save a life, but to welcome a new one. Nhi and Carlos fear the worst for a motorcyclist with life-threatening injuries after a horror crash. Sam and Chris race to a teen who’s had a seizure at home and whacked her head on the tiled floor.

South Australia’s first responders spring into action when calls for help come in. Ben and Mim find a grandfather in agony with horrific burns after spilling a huge pot of boiling water over himself. Lisa’s first day back from maternity leave has her examining a tiny baby with a soaring heart rate and high temperature. Sam and Chris treat a teen’s gruesome injuries after he attempted to jump a spiked fence. Bill treats a retired nurse who’s in agony from tripping while bringing in the bins.

Every few minutes a call for help comes through to South Australia’s paramedics. Aaron and Laura fear the worst as they rush to a teen victim of a frightening shark bite. Sam and Chris worry a woman’s next breath might be her last as she fights a chronic lung condition. Ben and Mim must tackle a footy player who’s dislocated his shoulder and super mums, Sally and Olivia race to a terrified one year old who’s crashed through a glass coffee table.

This is what it’s been building up to, The Grand Final is here. Which of the successful semi-finalists will be crowned champion of Robot Wars: The Third Wars?

Initially released on VHS and broadcast on TV a year later, the World Championship featured sixteen robots from eleven different countries. A straight knockout competition would decide which robot would be known as the World Champion.

The wars begin yet again, competitors can only qualify by destroying or outsmarting their opponents, and doing their best to stay out of the house robots way. Sumo and Pinball Warrior will test the robots grit and accuracy.

Six competitors, including World Champion Razer battle it out for a shot at the Fourth Wars title. Irreparable damage could mean the permanent end of one of the veteran competitors in the semi-finals.

A competitor faces issues before the battle even begins in this week’s eliminators and the house robots stand by, ready to strike the final blow. The clock proves to be the enemy in this week’s Pinball Warrior, and the competitors prepare to stand their ground in Sumo Bash.

Veterans and Newcomers once again face the eliminators and Dead Metal tries to make a friend. A house robot gets flipped, causing the others to go on a rampage. A uniquely designed robot takes on Pinball Warrior and two more competitors stare down Shunt in Sumo Bash.

A single strike spells trouble for a robot in the eliminators. A fleeting alliance forms as competitor and house robot team up to make an offering to the pit. This week’s Pinball Warrior has high-hopes for a standout performance.

A robot with a unique strategy takes part in this week’s heat. Is it a recipe for success, or a fancy gimmick? The house robot’s manners are at an all-time low as they continue to attack after cease is called.
The robots take the term “facing off” literally this week as they rip each other apart. Will Shunt manage to shake off the competitors in this week’s Sumo Bash.
The heat descends into chaos as the house robots team up to take down the competitors. The judges make a controversial decision in the final to decide this week’s winner.
Over halfway through the heats and the hopefuls are still lining up to put their robots through mechanical hell, for a chance of making it to the semi-finals.
An apparent malfunction gives a veteran competitor an opportunity to redeem themselves in the eliminators. The World Champion returns to take on the Pinball Warrior.
Sparks fly in this week’s heat as competitors put their weapons to good use and a robot uses its shape to their advantage.

The eliminator begins slowly, but as the battle heats up the robots must stay cool, or they might end up losing their head. The house robots see one of their busiest nights in the arena as they try to keep up.
Celebrities take to the arena, teaming up with veterans from the series and their robots. The celebrities must control the robots for at least 60 seconds before the professionals can take over.

From the producers of Robot Wars, Rescue Robots is a robot inspired, challenge based gameshow. Teams of children pilot their chosen robots and attempt to overcome pre-set obstacles, prevent imminent disasters and save Calamity City.
Transporter, Ranger and Talon face a potential nuclear disaster. Will the team prevent meltdown, or will this challenge prove too explosive for them?
The water pressure’s rising and if the team don’t get there soon the whole of Calamity City will be underwater. Will the team sink or swim?
A series of major fires have broken out on the outskirts of Calamity City. Will the team extinguish the inferno before it blows it destroys all in its path?
A satellite with vital scientific data has crash landed in the desert. Will the team be able to retrieve it safely, or will the information be lost forever?

The Portwenn surgery has reopened, but between Martin and Louisa sharing the office and a less-than-competent new receptionist, things aren't running very smoothly.

Martin advises a patient suffering from migraines to stop cold-water swimming; Mrs. Tishell's attempts to help almost lead to disaster; Martin has his own headaches to deal with when a herbalist sets up shop in the village; an ex-flame arrives.

programmes.t: Chuck And The First Peoples Kitchen
programmes.d: Chuck meets Captain Norbert Fontaine and his sons and embarks on a snow crab fishing sea adventure. Norbert is a very skilled captain from the Innu community Uashat Mak Mani-Utenam, who was one of the firsts Innu to receive his boat captain certificate.

Jamie kicks things off by cooking up his Crazy Good Pork Burger—a naughty little treat that takes fast food to the next level. Then it’s sticky mango prawns, a speedy sharing platter with a shortcut to phenomenal flavor.

The art of cooking once and eating twice. Today Silvia makes some divine ricotta filled Italian crepes, and then using the leftover ingredients shows us how to create a rustic story pie from the North of Italy and a heart baked - pasta, Pasta Al Forno.
In the Capital of Weird, a diverse group of chefs create mouth-watering plant-based dumplings, -  fried “chik’n” sandwiches, and Vietnamese “catfish”.
It’s time to go big or go home. Our dessert makers are challenged to push themselves to new heights and build a dessert structure that reaches a minimum height of half a metre.
On Jamie's menu is Asian sea bass, sticky rice, and dressed greens; plus chorizo carbonara and Catalan market salad.
Jenn visits northern Saskatchewan to learn how to catch, clean and cook walleye.
Fruit mousses are a staple in patisseries, and come in all sorts of colours and shapes. They can be a dessert on their own or part of a grand torte.
Pastry chefs are responsible for making their own ice cream in restaurants, and our creativity can really shine through.

The home cooks start out by preparing the dishes that made them famous in their own worlds, and Chef Daniela Manrique Lucca has everyone saying “Ooo, Mami!” when she reveals the contents of her fridge.

Jamie starts by cooking up his Tikka Chicken - it’s the quickest roast you’ll ever make. Next, there’s a vibrant carrot and grain salad you can whip up in minutes, and super speedy crab spaghetti—a luxurious and uncomplicated date night dinner.

Today Silvia explores how to make 3 meals that have actually become national treasures, like the 1000 year old recipe for Pasta Amatriciana, Plus a seafood dish from the Puglia region that is largely unknown to the outside world. And a pizza dish so cherished, its recipe is protected by the EU and the United Nations, Pizza Napoletana.

Graveyard Carz returns to conclude the epic builds of Chris Jacob’s 1968 GTX after it suffered a devastating fire, and the first of it’s kind 1970 Plymouth Superbird equipped with a Hellcat Crate Hemi.

New Season, New Carz! With SEMA in their rear-view mirror, the ghouls begin the final assembly of a 1969 Plymouth GTX in Seafoam Turquoise. And when help comes up short-handed, Mark enlists what he likes to call his “Echo Bomber.”
It’s the 100th Episode! Join Mark and Royal and watch the never-before-aired Pilot featuring some of the first Mopar restorations the original ghouls tackled over ten-years ago.

It’s a hectic day at the Graveyard. Dave jumps from car to car, installing and assembling what he can, Will struggles to keep focused on one project at a time, and Mark makes progress on his A100 build with the hopes of revealing at SEMA 2018!

Professional wrestler, actor, and former professional football player known for his time in the WWE and WCW as Goldberg returns to the Graveyard! This time, he brings the ghouls two brand new projects - one of which includes installing a brand-new 392 Crate Hemi in his modern Dodge Truck.

The Ghouls say goodbye to the 1970 Superbird equipped with a Hellcat Crate Hemi by taking it out for one last drive. Then it’s all hands on deck to get the beautiful second-generation Plymouth GTX in Seafoam Turquoise finished in time for the owner to see it for the first time since his father drove it.

With a Plymouth GTX finished, the ghoulz refocus their efforts on the 1969 Dodge Daytona. With the owner wanting a full restoration, Mark and the Ghouls begin the tedious disassembly. Because of the car’s pristine condition, they take extra effort to document and preserve as much as they can.

The unsung heroes of the body shop begin the restoration on one of the most requested renovations ever: a 1971 Dodge Demon. With several panels needing replacement, Mark and George show the intricate process of grafting an entire front-clip from another vehicle to replace the rusted and damaged original.
It’s crunch time at Graveyard Carz, Mark and his cousin Dougie fire up the engine for our Turbine Bronze Charger while Dave assembles its firewall in preparation to install the drivetrain.

Dave is ready to wrap up the 1970 Challenger R/T SE but is waiting for parts. Meanwhile, Mark’s A100 build continues, and after a long and tedious body-work and paint phase, Will is ready to deliver Dave the 1969 B5 Blue Plymouth GTX.

The Ghoulz have finished the 1970 Challenger R/T SE. As they take it out for the first test drive in over 15 years, Mark and the team reflect on the trials and challenges throughout the restoration process.

Mark, Dougie, and Allysa team up to kick things into high-gear around the shop. They begin the restoration of a Challenger T/A, Will paints a 1968 GTX in B7 Blue, Allysa learns how dashes are assembled, and they install the drivetrain for the ultra rare, 1 of 2, 1970 Hemi Convertible Coronet R/T.
Mark pulls back the curtain on the next four Mopar’s in desperate need of resurrection while also showcasing the fans favorite moments from Seasons 8 and 9.

programmes.t: LoudQUIETloud: A Film About the Pixies
programmes.d: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. Almost 30 years after Stiv's mysterious death in Paris, the Dead Boys have become the stuff of (Punk) legends but unsurprisingly, the story remains largely untold. Welcome back to Strongman Champions League for another stage of the 2022 world tour. We’re in Esposende - Portugal in this beautiful setting next to the beach in front of a packed crowd with some of the strongest men the world has to offer. With a real Porsche deadlift and many other crazy stuff. So, lets get this show started.

Hello and welcome in Gloucester, UK. The world tour hasn’t been here for what feels like forever. And now for the first time in the Mekka of Strongman, the SCL World series will crown a great Champion with the SCL Title. It will be full with special wooden events, and a great winner! So ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, brace yourselves because I present to you strongman champions league UK.

We are in Sopot, Poland the home of Legends Mariusz Pudzianowkski and Krzystof Radzikowski. Who will grab the title here in holiday resort Sopot, on the great Balrtic Sea with 6 events and 12 athlets in the mix!
We are in Sopot, Poland, after 3 events the Polish Strongman Oskar Ziolkowski is Leading. Kelvin, Travis and Aivars are coming up and will try to beat him, but will Oskar take his first title ever?

it’s been a long time since the world series held a championship here in Sarajevo. Let’s see what test of strength this destination holds for our athletes. And what fantastic athletes are here again in Stage 12 of the SCL World Series. The strongman champions league Bosnia is another iconic Strongman event with the return of Rongo Keen from Australia and Portugal winner 2022 George Sulaiman.

Welcome to Sibiu in Romania. It’s an important day for some of these athletes, because four of them have a real chance of getting into our all-exclusive world finals. There’s only one more stage after this to get those all-important extra points. So, there’s going to be some fireworks, who will take the title here and who will qualify for the World Finals?
This is it the last show before the world final. These guys have really got to fight for the points now, this is going to be action packed, whilst these guys fight it out all day.

We are in Alanya, on Turkey’s south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season of Strongman Champions League. Here in the sunshine, we’ll finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is. You could not ask for a better setting. After months of hard-work, if not years for some of these lads, we find out who will take the world title.

Welcome, to day two of the strongman champions league 2022 finals here in Alanya, Turkey. It’s all up for grabs now, everyone is fighting for the world title belt. This is an epic episode where we finally crown the World champion of 2022.

Welcome to the 2023 Strongman Champions League in Vaasa, Finland! This year’s event introduces a knockout format with 6 intense events over 90 minutes, ending in a unique deadlift face-off with boats.

Stage 2 of the Strongman Champions League 2023 is set in Zrenjanin, Serbia. This exciting event features 5 challenging contests, including a superhuman Yoke race. As the SCL World Series Tour continues, athletes will battle it out to claim the yellow leader’s position for the season. Don’t miss this incredible stage of strength and endurance!

The World’s Strongest Team will be crowned in this edition of SCL, here in Kalajoki-Finland we’ve picked some of the best in the business, teamed them up, and they’ll be going all out against each other. It’s now no longer about being a lonely wolf, but more about the pack mentality. It is a competition over 7 events, including a Big 2-man Log lift and heavy deadlift. Let’s start the action.

Strongman Champions League in Holland at the Dru Factory in ULFT. A great location for a spectacular battle with 14 Athletes over 3 events! The first 3 events in this episode are Truckpull/ Superyoke and Farmerswalk, with 2 massive logs of 150 kg in their hands. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it’s the circus of the extreme.

Ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, strongman fans across the world, we are back for SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it’s about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland, continues with the last 3 events, here at the Dru Factory in ULFT. The events in this episode are the Viking Press, Wheel Flip and the Atlas Stones, with 180 kg in the end.

For the first time ever, the World’s Strongest Latino competition has begun. This two-day event in Porto, Portugal, features 20 athletes from around the world competing in 8 events. After 4 grueling events, the top 12 will advance to the finals.

Strongman Champions League World Record Breakers 2023 starts with a 25-ton snow plow! Crazy machines are pulled and pushed, with many kilograms moved. A few new world records are set in this competition.

We have returned to the powerhouse of Portugal for an edge-of-your-seat galactic battle. If all the planets collided at once, it wouldn’t compare to the bang of this show. Get ready for the battle of the beasts; it’s the heaviest show in the universe, the Strongman Champions League.

SCL UK has landed in Gloucester it is workout war fitness for the ferocious, it’s going to be a a battle of the brutal, a rampage of the roofless. This is going to be a massacre of the muscles. You know it by now, but just in case you don’t, this is strongman champions league.

On the menu this week it’s medieval madness, we’ve come back to the middle ages to test our noble men through a muscle gaining of events. They are hoping and we are hoping that one will survive to take the title of the world’s strongest Viking. The official World's Strongest Viking is this time in Finland.

This week is a good one, can you feel the energy? Sit still, just look at me and try and feel the energy, because I can tell you, the atmosphere here is electric, it’s explosive, there is a pure elemental force going through these athletes' veins. I’m shaking because it’s Poland, it’s powerful, it’s strongman champions league, and you know what I'm going to say, get ready because it’s about to get heavy.

SCL Poland part 2 - Who will win the title in Poland and take 25 points for the world ranking. It is very exciting on the top, in part 1 between Poland and Latvia. Another great episode with super strongman events such as: Bag Toss Medley, Log Lift Reps and the Powerstairs. Also an interview with Mateusz Kieloszkowski, the all time favorite champion from Poland.

It’s time to show our strength and gain respect from the gods of Olympus. Our gladiators have many events set out by no other than Hercules himself. The coliseum is ready here on this mythological island of Cyprus, so we have landed in Limassol were again 12 Top Strongmen are battling for the title and ranking points.

The only and official world championship Truckpulling for its 10th year, again at the Strongman Champions league. With the 3 times Worldchampion Kelvin de Ruiter – defending his title. This championship has trucks in all shapes and sizes which is a lot like our athletes, there all different pay loads, but does the biggest win or is it the strongest.

Years and years of determination has brought us here today, when all the walls felt like they were caving in perseverance. When their bodies were screaming, hurting, shouting stop, beneath. These are the things which make up a man, these are the things that bring you world finalists. This episode they fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever.

Part 2 of the World Finals of the Strongman Champions League tour 2023 at the Sarajevo Centar Skenderija in Bosnia. 3 Events was done already and amazing results have been set. Who will be the new World champion? Find out here, who, after 16 stages, will be crowned World Champion 2023.

After 10 years there is another edition of THE ICEMAN in minus 25 degrees and snow, and it is also the first stage in the MLO Strongman Champions League. With a new World champion from South Africa, Rayno Nel, it will be a challenging year for all the athletes to win the title again after 1 full year. But now they can win one very exceptional title, which is the SCL ICEMAN!

A battle in the beautiful Caribbean Islands. Over 2 days and more than 10,000 spectators expected like previous editions. The cold temperature from the Iceman is changed in 35 degrees hot Martinique. Watch who gets the title in Martinique, events include: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Hercules Hold, Log Lift, and Arm Over Arm Pull.

The SCL Hungary this year is in the AQUAPARK in Budapest, Stage 3 from the spectacular MLO Strongman Champions League, World is Biggest Pro League. With five great events, such as: Viking Press, Farmer's Walk, Deadlift, Conan's Wheel, and A loading race with Beer barrels of 200 Kg. It is a must see!

We're in Zrenjanin, Serbia, again a fantastic stage in the SCL WORLD SERIES TOUR 2024, five events including a super human Yoke race. Who will be the yellow leader for the coming season and take the title with 25 championship points?

We're in Groenlo, east of Holland With the new Talent from South Africa and 2025 Strongest Man of the World - Rayno Nel. The first 3 events are Truckpull, Log Lift and Loading race. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it is the circus of the extreme.

SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it is about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland , continues with the last 3 events, here at the venue in Groenlo. The events in this episode are the Conan Wheel, Farmers Walk and the Atlas Stones, with a brutal 200kg stone at the end.

Strongman Champions League: World Record Breakers 2024 kicks off with the Truck Pull, followed by the Front Hold, Frame Carry, Tractor Pull, Shield Carry, Sandbag Toss, and concludes with the intense Loading Race. This two-day competition features all the top strongmen from Finland-and it's one for the history books. Three new world records are shattered, making this a must-see episode for...

For the first time in over 10 years back in Estonia, in Tartu. 12 of the Strongest athletes in the world will fight here for the title and the overall world championship points. You will see 5 crazy events, such as: Boat Pull, Viking Press, Medley, Conan's Wheel and a very heavy Power Stairs!

We have returned to Portugal, at the beach of Eposende, to bring you EUROPE'S STRONGEST LATINO. In the beautiful sun of Portugal five cruel events are done in this heat: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Log Lift, Sandbag Toss, Medley.

A spectacular event on the beach of Gdansk, Poland. A competition in the sand and in the water. Complete with a boat pull. With an impressive line up again, we welcome you to watch us LIVE in the SCL Poland.

The Strongman Champions League Train stops in Dubai again for the 3rd time, and is now bigger than ever. Hafthor Bjornsson makes his come back here at the SCL DUBAI. You simply cannot miss this most epic show at the World Trade Center in Dubai part 1.

After three cruel events in part 1, the World record holder on the deadlift with 501 Kg, will fight for the crown and the title. You simply cant miss this most epic show, at in the World Trade Center in Dubai part 2.

Superhumans arrive in Limassol. Great strongmen from all over the world will compete in the Old Port of Limassol , for the title and championship points. More than ever important this stage, as we come so close to the World Finals in Turkey this year.

With 12 of the world's best athletes arriving in Cape Town, South Africa, all fighting for the crown and final ranking points ahead of the World Finals in Turkey. Rayno Nel still needs to qualify along with Brian Kichton also battling for a seat in the World Finals.

This episode contestants fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever. Twelve finalists from all over the world are in Turkey and will fight for the ultimate title: WORLD CHAMPION 2024.
Part 2 of the world final of the Strongman Champions League tour 2024 in Alanya, Turkey. With three Events down and amazing results. Who will be the new World champion?

Strongman Champions League 2025 opens in Joensuu, Finland in freezing -5°C conditions. Athletes battle frame carry as first event on ice and snow. Brian Kichton sets early pace, but Kevin Hazeleger ultimately wins with 27.57s. Competitors from USA, Finland, Turkey and others struggle with cold and debut performances, setting the tone for a global season. Cold conditions define the opening stage.

While Scott, Lydia and Malia search for Stiles, Liam and the others throw a party to keep a friend safe from the Ghost Riders.
Scott and Liam protect the lacrosse team from an attack by the Ghost Riders while Lydia searches for clues that lead her closer to finding Stiles.
Trapped inside the Wild Hunt, Stiles reunites with an unexpected ally while Scott, Lydia and Malia discover Stiles’s Jeep may be connected to his disappearance.
Scott, Lydia and Malia search for clues about the Wild Hunt in a mysterious place called Canaan while Liam and Hayden resort to drastic measures in the fight against the Ghost Riders.
Scott and Liam attempt to capture a Ghost Rider while Malia and Peter search for a way into the Wild Hunt.
Running out of time, Scott, Lydia and Malia decide to storm the rift in a desperate attempt to get Stiles back. Liam, Hayden and Mason make a deal with Theo in order to learn Douglas's real plan.
While Liam and Theo act as decoys, Scott, Lydia and Malia enact a desperate plan to try and remember Stiles.
With the fate of Beacon Hills hanging in the balance, Scott and his pack face off against Douglas in a final showdown.
As Scott readies Beacon Hills for his imminent departure, a mysterious presence breaks out of Eichen House.
Scott and Malia search for the owner of a unique bullet, fearing that a new breed of werewolf hunter has come to Beacon Hills. At the same time, Lydia must face her own fears of Eichen House.
While Scott and the others desperately pursue a missing werewolf, Melissa and Argent investigate the nature of a strange body.
Scott, Lydia and Malia have to take drastic measures to quell the growing violence in Beacon Hills, while Liam endures his own gauntlet at the high school.
When Scott and the others try to protect two new werewolves, an unlikely ally joins the fight.
Liam and Theo attempt to draw the Hunters away from Beacon Hills.
After a shocking attack leaves the pack reeling, Scott sets out to recruit reinforcements.
Scott and the others must make a discovery before it’s too late.
Scott and Malia prepare for battle while Argent searches for an old ally.
Gerard initiates his final attack on the Supernaturals of Beacon Hills.

When teenager Scott McCall (Tyler Posey) is convinced by his best friend, Stiles (Dylan O'Brien), to join a search in the woods for a missing body, something comes out of the darkness to take a bite out of his side, changing his life forever.

Not aware that he has become a werewolf, Scott (Tyler Posey) must deal with hunters trying to catch him, another werewolf (Tyler Hoechlin) and the pressures of normal teen life, all while trying to get a second date with Allison (Crystal Reed).

Scott's (Tyler Posey) first date with Allison (Crystal Reed) ends up in confusion and turns into a dreaded "group date." Meanwhile, a mystery animal attack has Sheriff Stilinski (Linden Ashby) and the rest of Beacon Hills on the lookout.

With his life in danger, Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) is forced to make reluctant allies out of Scott (Tyler Posey) and Stiles (Dylan O'Brien). While Scott tries to survive dinner with Allison's father (JR Bourne), Stiles attempts to keep Derek alive.

A new animal attack raises more questions among authorities. And when Scott (Tyler Posey) and Allison (Crystal Reed) skip school unannounced, Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) must deal with the ever more aggressive werewolf hunters on his own.

Scott (Tyler Posey) and Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) come up with ways for Scott to control the transformation in order to be with Allison (Crystal Reed), while Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) attempts to make an ally of Scott in his battle with the hunters.

When Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) is savagely attacked by the Alpha, Scott (Tyler Posey), Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) and their friends find themselves trapped in Beacon Hills High School at night where they face both questions and suspicions about each other.

With Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) on the run from Sheriff Stilinski (Linden Ashby), Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) must help Scott (Tyler Posey) face his second full moon. Meanwhile, Jackson (Colton Haynes) tries to get closer to Allison (Crystal Reed).

Clues, including a prior encounter with Derek (Tyler Hoechlin), bring Jackson (Colton Haynes) to a dangerous revelation about Scott (Tyler Posey)…and his actions begin to threaten not only Scott's life, but his own as well.

With startling revelations weighing in on him, Scott (Tyler Posey) finds himself scrambling to protect the people he loves, including Allison (Crystal Reed) who begins to follow clues left by her Aunt Kate about her family history.

While struggling with family secrets, Allison (Crystal Reed) focuses on the Winter Formal dance. Meanwhile, as the tensions between werewolves and hunters rise to a boiling point, Scott (Tyler Posey) struggles to protect both friends and enemies.

In the season finale, Scott McCall (Tyler Posey) discovers one last clue which allows him to enlist both friends -- and even a previous enemy -- in order to stop the mysterious killings and win back Allison (Crystal Reed), the girl he loves.

When Lydia (Holland Roden) goes missing from the hospital, werewolves and hunters alike begin a search to discover not only where she is, but what she may have become. Meanwhile Jackson's (Colton Haynes) body seems to be fighting against the bite.

The night before a full moon, Isaac's father (John Wesley Shipp) is murdered. When Isaac (Daniel Sharman) is arrested, Scott (Tyler Posey), Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) and Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) resolve to break him out before the Argents get to him.

Scott (Tyler Posey) tries to stop Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) from creating new werewolves, while Chris Argent (JR Bourne) decides to officially begin Allison's (Crystal Reed) training. Meanwhile, the new creature in Beacon Hills takes another victim.

When the shapeshifter strikes again, Scott (Tyler Posey) has to recruit a reluctant Allison (Crystal Reed) to acquire a rare book from Gerard's (guest star Michael Hogan) collection, while also once again surviving dinner with the Argents.

Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) becomes convinced that Lydia (Holland Roden) is the shapeshifter they're after since she seemed immune to its toxin, forcing Scott (Tyler Posey) to gather his friends -- and even some enemies -- to protect her.

With startling new information about the shapeshifter, Scott (Tyler Posey) and Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) hurry to protect their friends while Allison (Crystal Reed) is given an investigative task by her family. And there is "panic at the disco."

Lydia (Holland Roden) makes connections about the bite from Peter (Ian Bohen). Jackson (Colton Haynes) causes problems for Scott (Tyler Posey) and Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) while Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) has a crisis of faith in his leadership abilities.

During a secret concert, Scott (Tyler Posey) and Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) come up with a method to trap the new shapeshifter. At the same time, Allison's mother (Eaddy Mays) comes up with a plan of her own to take care of Scott once and for all.

Even as his relationship with Allison (Crystal Reed) is further strained, Scott (Tyler Posey) must attend Lydia's (Holland Roden) birthday party while Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) locks up his new wolves on their first full moon together.

With a secret revealed, Scott (Tyler Posey), Stiles (Dylan O'Brien), Melissa and Stilinski are taken hostage in the Sheriff's station. Allison (Crystal Reed) then tracks Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) to the station, bringing Argent and Gerard with her.

Scott (Tyler Posey) must help win the championship lacrosse game while also trying to figure out how to stop Gerard (Michael Hogan). At the same time, Alison (Crystal Reed) and Argent (JR Bourne) continue their hunt of Derek (Tyler Hoechlin).

In the second season finale, although everyone is still reeling from a shocking death on the lacrosse field, Scott (Tyler Posey) and his friends rush to figure out Gerard's (Michael Hogan) master plan…but Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) has his own plan.

In the exciting Season 3 premiere, a new Alpha Pack arrives to wreak havoc on Scott's (Tyler Posey) life, while Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) and Isaac (Daniel Sharman) struggle to locate Erica (Gage Golightly) and Boyd (Sinqua Walls).

Allison and Lydia stumble on a clue to finding Boyd and Erica, while a childhood friend of Stiles goes missing. Meanwhile, Derek is surprised by the reappearance of someone from his past…someone he thought had died in the Hale house fire.

With Boyd (Sinqua Walls) and Cora (Adelaide Kane) on the loose and under the influence of the full moon, Scott (Tyler Posey) and Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) find that they may have to turn to an unlikely ally for help…Chris Argent (JR Bourne).

While Scott (Tyler Posey) tries to keep Isaac (Daniel Sharman) from engaging in a deadly confrontation with the Twins in school, Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) attempts to prove his theory that the killings have absolutely nothing to do with werewolves.

During a bus ride to a cross country meet, Scott (Tyler Posey) and his friends flash back to the events of a preemptive strike against the Alphas that has left several injured and possibly one or more dead.

Stranded at a motel in Fairvale, California for the night because of a postponed meet, Scott (Tyler Posey) and the others suffer strange experiences that cause them to believe members of their own group may the mysterious killer's newest targets.

As the danger begins to move closer to Scott (Tyler Posey) his trusted mentor and boss, Deaton (Seth Gilliam), is threatened. Meanwhile, Kali (Felisha Terrell) and the twins (Charlie Carver and Max Carver) go after Derek (Tyler Hoechlin).

Seeking answers, Scott (Tyler Posey). Allison (Crystal Reed) and Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) hear stories told by two unlikely narrators -- Peter (Ian Bohen) and Gerard (Michael Hogan) -- and discover a secret about the color of a werewolf's eyes.

Ozzy appears on The Tonight Show with Jay Leno as a performer.
The family's dogs have been excreting far too many times in the house and ruining furniture in the process.
Ozzy releases his first solo album in six years.
Kelly complains that elder sister Aimee had booked her a gynaecologist appointment.
Ozzy is working out with a personal trainer in preparation for an upcoming tour.
Ozzy is touring while Sharon returns home, planning to reunite with Ozzy in Houston because she misses him.
Ozzy mixes alcohol with the pain medication for his foot injury and winds up stoned.
Jack invites his friend Jason Dill, a professional skateboarder, to stay at the house.
Sharon tells Ozzy and Jack that one of their tour truck drivers had an accident the other day.
Ozzy talks to Kelly and Melinda about being put in jail for stealing.
Sharon and the dogs are in the backyard, Lola then vomits on the grass.
Sharon recuperates at the family's Malibu beach house while undergoing treatment for colon cancer.
Kelly travels to Europe for a series of interviews and appearances.
Kelly begins dating Bert McCracken, lead singer of the band The Used.
Sharon makes amends with her father after not speaking with him for over twenty years.
Kelly recruits her friend Sarah to play the drums in her band.
Kelly grows frustrated with all the appearances she must make as a recording artist.
Ozzy grows increasingly tired of the dogs and their tendency to defecate in the house.
The Osbournes pack their bags for Sin City as Ozzy prepares for a concert and Kelly celebrates her birthday.
Sharon and Ozzy decide to renew their wedding vows at a hotel on New Year's Eve.
The Osbournes struggle to come up with a gift for Jack's birthday.
The pets suffer from a flea infestation, creating havoc around the house and leaving everyone miserable.
Ozzy continues to work out with his trainer, Pete, who Ozzy jokes may be a robot.

Like other Star Fleet vessels, Ship (voice of Malcolm McDowell) has evolved and now controls the only human (Jack Noseworthy) aboard. But the relationship takes a dramatic turn when Man meets Woman and fights machine in a desperate bid for freedom!

Do our memories define our identity? If we are merely the sum of our experiences, what do we become if those experiences are lost? Hope Wilson (Robbie Chong) faces this question when she meets a man who has purposely erased his own memories.

Courtesy of a freak accident (and The Outer Limits), an agoraphobe (Jane Adams) begins to hear the private thoughts of all of the tenants in her building...the good, the bad and the steamy. And it seems at least one of them may want to kill her.

A scientist -- who is also a religious zealot (David Ogden Stiers) -- secretly implants an embryo created with DNA from the Shroud of Turin into a young woman (Samantha Mathis) in order to scientifically engineer the Second Coming of Christ.

The Outer Limits come to Victorian Whitechapel when a London doctor (Cary Elwes) races to capture the alien creature responsible for the Jack the Ripper murders. But when the alien frames the good doctor for the murders, his time may be up.

The son (Saul Rubinek) of a concentration camp survivor (Peter Boretski) gets some unique help in proving the guilt of a former Nazi (Jan Rubes) living in the U.S....courtesy of a time traveler (Alex Daikun) and, of course, The Outer Limits.

The planets Earth and Dregocia struggle to re-establish a fragile trust after a summit goes tragically wrong. Can a diplomat (Marcia Cross) calm the hawkish nature of both species…and can she overcome her own prejudices to save both worlds?

A meek anthropologist (Leland Orser) develops a serum for genetic dominance and tests it on himself. Now his newfound confidence takes complete control of him, turning him into an irrational, overly aggressive troglodyte! Can he reverse the process?

The Haven is a high-tech apartment building which is run by supercomputer and almost completely eliminates the need for human contact. But when things begin to go wrong, neighbors who have never met must learn to work together in order to survive!

When a scientist's (Kevin Nealon) experiment unintentionally creates a rift in the space-time continuum, he suddenly find himself caught in a time loop and soon begins to suspects sabotage. Terri Hawkes, Jennifer Copping and Ronny Cox also star.

A boy (Adam Hann-Byrd) , picked on by high-school bullies and neglected by his own father (Daniel Hugh Kelley), finds comfort in an alien (Chris Potter) who has crash-landed on earth. But is the alien what he claims to be? Never…in The Outer Limits.

In a world dominated by alien invaders, a cynical American cafe owner (Nathan Fillion) must decide if he will risk his life to help an old lover fight for Earth or if he is happy not rocking the political boat. Derek de Lint also stars.

When Detective Terry Russo (Megan Gallagher) is called to investigate a double murder, she discovers she may be solving not one crime, but possibly hundreds. And that the culprit -- or culprits -- may not be human at all. Michael Riley also stars.

A convicted murderer is turned loose only to be hunted by the sister of his victim as part the hottest show on television, Judgment Day, which allows the family members -- and the at home audience -- to act as judge, jury and executioner!

An ex-con who had been serving time for spousal abuse is bent on revenge against his wife. He purchases a strange handgun from a gun dealer and finds this is no ordinary weapon and, in fact, he becomes quite attached to it…literally.

A device that allows people to change their appearance helps a nerdy guy become the mirror image of his hunky co-worker.. Now arrogant with his new-found good looks, the former nerd experiences a life like never before…and now he wants to keep it.

An invisible alien race that inhabits the energy systems of a deserted spaceship envelopes the crew of a salvage team, responding to the empty vessel's distress signal, in a web of paranoia, suspicion and murder. Michael Shanks stars.

When a scientist uses his time machine to travel into the future, he discovers his wife lying dead in a pool of blood and a man fleeing the scene. Determined save her, he uses the time machine to go back in time...but is her death inevitable?

A blind man (Mackenzie Astin) regains his sight only to be used by the government for his unique ability to see an alien from another dimension who has been trapped on Earth and yearns to return home. But the government has other plans for her.

A veterinarian (Jessica Tuck) in a small farming community becomes alarmed when a genetically-engineered corn seed, intended to produce faster, larger yields of corn, produces something far more alarming …human mutations! Len Cariou also stars.

After losing his wife and son in a horrific car accident some twenty years earlier, a scientist (Joel Gray) uses advanced technology to build the perfect robotic version of his son. But perfection is not always so perfect...in The Outer Limits.

Due to dwindling resources in the future, the world consists of "Alphas" and "Betas" who are alternately put in stasis for 72 hour periods, all in service to the "Elites," who lord over the Alphas and the Betas...But a resistance is coming.

When a man arrives at al UFO convention with part of an alien ship, it throws the annual gathering of "true believers" into chaos and leads to a conspiracy, a cover-upï¿½and murder. But who is conspiring with whom? And what are they covering up?

After being brought back from death, a woman (Laura Leighton) discovers she was one part of a pair of conjoined twins, the other lost during pregnancy. And now that twin, living dormant in her body for all these years, wants a life of her own.

Tom (Tate Donovan) and Wendy (Gabrielle Miller) are the perfect couple, happy and very much in love. But at night, Tom has terrible memory flashes about being stuck in a burning building The nightmares, however, aren't real…and neither is Tom.

After the plane he is traveling in is struck by lightning, a Presidential candidate is visited by a time traveler who tells him that he needs to escape impending death because his presidency is the key to preventing an apocalyptic future.

The crew of a space salvage ship is awakened from hyper-sleep when they come across a mysterious object floating through space. They soon discover the pod contains a tyrant, in stasis, who was banished from Earth for crimes against humanity.

A man travels back to his home town in order to investigate his brother's murder, allegedly at the hands of his brother's wife. He quickly discovers his hometown has drastically changed...and the residents seem to be under some form of mind control.

A preacher (Gary Busey), who lost his faith when his wife died, performs staged healing miracles at tent revivals until he finds his faith -- and livelihood -- being tested as never before by the appearance of a mysterious wheelchair-bound man.

Two friends re-enacting the Battle of Gettysburg unwittingly find themselves transported back in time and taken prisoner by a deranged Confederate colonel (Meatloaf) who might not only endanger their future…but the future of the country as well.

A teenage boy (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) suspects that the tenant (Judd Nelson) now taking up residence in his mother's backyard apartment is actually an alien on a deadly mission…a suspicion that puts the boy and his mother in grave danger.

An anarchist (Frank Whaley), who was once rabidly pro-technology, threatens to blow up the central computers that control the world. As he negotiates with Pete Yastremski (John Amos) to surrender, we discover what led him down this dark path.

When the leader of an Arctic exploration team kills two colleagues, psychologist Jack Burrell (William Cummins) is sent up to counsel the staff, including an old "friend" (Robert Sean Leonard), and to find the cause of an infectious psychosis.

Time-traveler Dr. Theresa Givens (Amanda Plummer) faces the death penalty for using her time machine in a future where all technology is banned due to a devastating nuclear holocaust some 20 years earlier. Charlton Heston also stars.

An overworked father who wants to relieve the tension in his home due to the demands of his job orders a robot to keep house and perform other chores. Much to the father's surprise, the robot starts to replace him as head of the household.

A military colonel travels into the past from a plagued-ridden future where billions have died from a deadly virus. His mission: track down Patient Zero, the woman who had all three strains of DNA that produced the virus and assassinate her.

A couple and their friend join a mysterious religious sect in order to lead a more spiritual existence and find a new direction in life. They soon learn, however, that their new-found direction may take them further than they ever thought possible.

Young and artistic Claire Linkwood, who struggles financially to make ends meet, volunteers for a surrogate mother program. But after the embryo is successfully implanted at the clinic, she begins to have nightmares of a most "alien" nature.

The lone survivor (Jere Burns) of a space shuttle disaster discovers he's greatly transformed since surviving the crash. For one, his body seems to be indestructible, and he embraces a new-found humanity…courtesy of The Outer Limits.

Mona Lisa, an android who was created to spy and kill, is designed with superior intelligence. But it is that superior intellect which allows her to evolve, leading her to question the morality of her prime directive...and her own existence.

A biogeneticist clones successfully his wife, who is near death in a coma with no expectation of survival. But when his real wife suddenly awakens from her coma, he finds life with not one, but two wives may be quite complicated.

A man (Enrico Colantoni) has second thoughts about a process that transmits a copy of a person light years away but requires that the human "shell" left behind be destroyed in order to maintain a balance in the Universe.

An unemployed man wanders into a curio shop owned by a shape-shifting alien and is offered a rather unique wallet...one that fills with the money of anyone the man comes in physical contact with. However, if it's too good to be true, it often is.

A dying scientist (Joanna Going) makes it her mission to save a mutant "child" -- a link to another dimension of time and space -- from those scientists who seek fame and from shadowy government forces that desire to exploit it.

A four-person space crew travels through a wormhole that lands them in an unknown universe where Native American Astrophysicist Callie Whitehorse Landau experiences bizarre hallucinations that reveal the true nature of the entire universe.

Conocidos como los "Constructores del Horror", la desaparición de Jocelyne y Jean-Claude Saint Aubert conmocionó a su tranquilo barrio.
En las primeras horas de la mañana, Mathilde Croguennec, de 18 años, que asiste a "Teknival" en Bretaña, es encontrada al pie de un árbol con la garganta cortada.
Ruth Ellis fue la última mujer ahorcada en Gran Bretaña.
Julie Michel, de 26 años, desapareció en julio de 2013, mientras recorría Francia en un viaje en solitario en su Renault 21 Nevada.

En este episodio repasamos tres casos de chicas desaparecidas en Bizkaia y que generaron una gran intranquilidad en la sociedad vasca: Laura Orue (1999), Virginia Acebes (1999) y Aintzane Garay (2005).Un repaso a los hechos que marcaron a toda una comunidad.
Koldo Larrañaga asesinó a Begoña Rubio en su despacho de abogada de Vitoria, donde dejó varias pruebas incriminatorias.
Donna, una madre soltera de cuatro hijos en la ciudad de Nueva York, es una trabajadora auxiliar de enfermería que desesperadamente quiere un esposo y una figura paterna para sus hijos.
Lori se sintió no amada y torpe durante su infancia.

Una joven hermosa pero desorientada se convierte en stripper y termina arruinando públicamente su reputación. El incidente conduce a una serie de malas relaciones hasta que una noche apuñala a su amante durante una pelea física y termina en la cárcel.
Nancy es una mujer con un historial de relaciones fallidas.
La operación Kraken llevó a la desarticulación de una peligrosa banda organizada de paramilitares dedicada a la realización de robos con violencia en domicilios y locales comerciales.
Manuel Delgado Villegas, "El Arropiero", es conocido como el mayor asesino en serie de la historia de España.
Jameelah está estudiando para salir de la Baltimore urbana cuando se enamora de James, un traficante de drogas.
Es amor a primera vista para Jonathan y Courtney, quienes son sordos. Pero la luna de miel dura poco.
Sherrse Gaines se enamora perdidamente de su primer amor, Greg. Pero cuando él la engaña, ella lo deja.
Annette Hernández es hermosa, pero está atormentada por demonios mentales y adicciones.
Monica Fairview es una adicta a los "sugar daddies" que sale con hombres como Rob para mantener su vida de lujo.
El 18 de julio de 2011, Xavier Baligant, de 29 años, se pone en camino con sus dos hijos tras una semana de vacaciones en Ardèche para regresar a su casa en Nivelles, Bélgica.
El caso de Yoni Palmier, denominado "el asesino en serie de Essonne", se desarrolló rápidamente bajo la atenta mirada de la policía de Versalles.
Al llegar a su trabajo, la secretaria de una pequeña empresa en los suburbios de Ginebra encuentra el cuerpo de Jean-Raymond Blatti, el nuevo contador de la empresa.
Peter Manuel fue un asesino en serie escocés que mató al menos a ocho personas entre 1956 y 1958 en el área del Gran Glasgow en Escocia.
El 14 de julio de 2013, en Perpiñán, Marie-Josée Benitez, de 53 años, y su hija Allison, de 19, desaparecen repentinamente.
La misteriosa desaparición de Laëtitia Delecluse reveló una historia escalofriante de violencia doméstica y engaño.
El 20 de febrero de 2005, Christelle Leroy y su hijo Lucas, de 4 años, desaparecen misteriosamente.
